name: Range Dynamics
description: Some days, it’s all about punching holes and ringing steel. Fiocchi’s Range Dynamics centerfire rifle cartridges have you covered for high-volume fun, equipment testing, and skill development. Available for all the popular chamber sizes, Range Dynamics ammunition utilizes flight-stable full metal jacket boattail bullets combined with the same high-quality components and construction serious shooters have come to expect from Fiocchi.

name: Steward Collection
description: The STEWARD COLLECTION delivers benchrest precision and explosive on-target performance for anything that threatens your herd. Utilizing the Sierra Tipped VarmintKing (formerly Tipped BlitzKing), and backed by Barnes' uncompromising standards, the Steward Collection runs true and hits hard - just like the men and women who carry it. Every shot honors the stock you raise, the land you work, and the wild you protect. Designed for predator and varmint control, this ammo means business - because protecting what's yours takes more than fences.

name: Modern Sporting
description: Talley Modern Sporting Ring is a solution for your Picatinny rail system with a clean appearance. Machined from aircraft grade alloy and has a black anodize finish.

name: Trophy Grade Long Range Rifle
description: The AccuBond -Long Range bullet line was developed in response to the escalating demand from long-range hunters who were asking for a hunting bullet that could keep up with today's level of high-grade optics and ultra-high velocity cartridges in order to stretch practical shooting yardages past 1,000 yards; yet still perform on big-game animals. In order to accommodate these extreme parameters, the AccuBond® -LR bullet was designed to have a minimum impact velocity of 1300fps in order to reliably expand or mushroom at those much longer distances, compared to the 1800fps minimum impact velocity of all other Nosler hunting bullets. Now what about close range performance? Because the lead core is bonded to the copper jacket, the AccuBond-LR bullet will hold up to extreme velocities. To further assist performance at such a wide range of impact velocities, the copper jacket is tapered, meaning it is thin at the nose, becoming much thicker towards the boat-tail base.

name: Double X
description: Winchester Double X ammunition has been used by hunters for decades. The copper-plated shot is protected by Grex buffering and it hits hard, consistently dropping turkeys every season. Whether velocity or payload is a preference, Winchester offers both High Velocity and Magnum loads in the Double X line.

name: ACOG 4x32
description: The one that started it all. The concept was simple; a durable scope with a reticle that illuminates in low-light and no-light situations—without requiring the use of batteries. More than 30 years later, the original ACOG stands the test of time as one of our most popular items. Choose from many 4x32 options, including the Official Rifle Combat Optic (RCO) of the U.S. Marine Corps.

name: Nitro Turkey Load
description: Nitro Mag extra-hard lead shot. Patterns over 80% with Super Full choke. Patterns like copper-plated shot. 10 rounds per box.

name: Core-Lokt
description: Since 1939, more hunters have relied on Remington Core-Lokt than any other big game ammunition, and rightly so. It's filled more tags on more continents than any other load. Core-Lokt is the original controlled expansion bullet. Its time-proven performance has made it hunting's first choice for over 75 years. The tapered copper jacket is locked to a solid lead core delivering massive 2X expansion, weight retention and consistent on-game results. Available in soft point and pointed soft point versions, and in a range of bullet weights for virtually every centerfire hunting caliber made.

name: Thor 5
description: The ATN THOR 5 LRF (Long Range Fusion) is a cutting-edge thermal riflescope specifically designed for long-range shooting and observation. It combines advanced thermal imaging technology with laser rangefinding capabilities, providing shooters with exceptional performance and accuracy in various conditions. The THOR 5 LRF utilizes a high-resolution thermal sensor that detects the heat signatures emitted by objects, ensuring clear and detailed imaging even in complete darkness or adverse weather conditions such as fog or smoke. With its thermal imaging capability, this riflescope allows users to see through obstacles and identify targets that are otherwise hidden to the naked eye.

name: Skyline Precision Mount
description: The Warne® Skyline® Precision Mount has been engineered from the ground up with the precision rifle shooter/competitor in mind. Machined from 7075 T6 aluminum billet, and featuring 2 integral recoil lugs along with 4 mounting crossbolts, the precision mount easily handles the rigors of competition or hard use environments. The STANAG rail interface allows for more precise mount alignment, and return to zero capability than a traditional Mil Spec 1913 Picatinny interface while still being compatible with all picatinny rails. The Warne Skyline Precision Mount features a wide assortment of accessories that mount directly to 10 different interfaces on the scope rings. Look for Warne's complete line of Skyline Precision Shooting Accessories at your favorite retailer.

name: Select Plus
description: Ultra-high velocity, magnum ammunition is how Roy Weatherby got started in the 1940s. Today, those same performance qualities are every bit a part of Weatherby cartridges. Weatherby's move to Wyoming is an exciting step towards the continual opportunity for innovation. The cartridges that paved the way for advancement in ballistics and load development will forever be a solid foundation. Weatherby's intention is a constant progression for ballistic superiority, confidence in developing new and impressive cartridges that perform and meet expectations attached to the Weatherby brand.

name: Power Point
description: Winchester Super-X Power-Point Centerfire Rifle Ammo has proven itself for over 60 years to function reliably in all types of environmental conditions, as well as deliver lethal terminal performance on big game. This dual-sighting system gives the shooter a distinct tactical advantage with the option of either the Trijicon ACOG or RMR Type 2 sight. With the quick target acquisition of the RMR Type 2 Sight or the precise aiming capabilities provided by the magnified 4 power Trijicon ACOG the shooter has the ability to select the proper aiming solution for the situation at hand truly the best of both worlds. Today, those same performance qualities are every bit a part of Weatherby cartridges. Weatherby's move to Wyoming is an exciting step towards the continual opportunity for innovation. The cartridges that paved the way for advancement in ballistics and load development will forever be a solid foundation. Weatherby's intention is a constant progression for ballistic superiority, confidence in developing new and impressive cartridges that perform and meet expectations attached to the Weatherby brand.

name: Gold Medal Rimfire

name: American Eagle Handgun

This NCStar Tactical Dot Sight sports multiple similar or improved features at a more affordable price than its competition.

These aircraft-grade aluminum tactical rings feature six points of contact for maximum security and are designed to withstand the most grueling environments imaginable. name: Classic Pistol

name: Outfitter
description: From the backcountry to the back-forty, trust your hunt to Outfitter ammunition. Featuring corrosion resistant nickel-plated cases that are sealed watertight and topped with the accurate and rugged CX bullet, Outfitter ammunition is designed to perform under the toughest conditions.

name: Varmint Express

Polymer tipped V-MAX bullets deliver match accuracy, high ballistic coefficients, wind defying trajectories, and rapid fragmentation upon contact. Each Varmint Express offering is loaded with high quality cases and carefully selected propellant and primers that are chosen to provide the best performance in each individual load.

name: Military Service Grade Handgun
description: Featuring high quality Winchester components, this ammunition delivers outstanding reliability. Reliable, affordable loads for the high-volume shooter. Whether for practice, target shooting or training exercises, Military Service Grade ammunition is a superb choice for high volume shooting. This ammunition is new production, non-corrosive, in reloadable brass cases.

name: AUS Mount
description: Introducing the AUS Mount for magnified optics, from Reptilia. Driven by the request of an end user group, the AUS Mount is the culmination of a 2 year development program. Like the DOT Mount line, the AUS Mount attaches to any M1913 Picatinny rail via the anti-snag spring-loaded nitrided steel clamp and custom bolt mounting system which can be tightened with either a 5/32 hex or a flat blade driver to sit flush with the body of the mount for a low-profile, streamline design. Also like the DOT Mount line, the AUS mount is machined from a single piece of billet 7075-T6 aluminum and is finished with MIL-STD Type III, Class 2, hard anodize coating. The AUS is compatible with all of Reptilia's existing 30mm ROF line, and will be compatible with several new ROF products launching over the coming months. Like all Reptilia products, the AUS Mount is 100% Made in the USA.

name: Match Pro ED Binocular
description: The Match Pro ED 15x56 is a high-magnification binocular with a reticle. The binocular features Abbe-Koenig prisms; ED Prime glass; dual adjustable diopters; BridgeSet IPD stabilizer and the MRAD reticle that rotates The Shot-Call MRAD reticle. As you adjust binocular barrel distance the angle at the hinge changes. Not only can you have the binocular adjusted to your eyes and level on any terrain, but you can also level the reticle plumb for perfect spotting. You also have the option of mounting accessories- tripod adapter or the BridgeSet to either the front or rear bridges based on your preference.

name: Deer Season XP

Accuracy, combined with massive bullet impact performance means that Deer Season XP is a great choice for all deer hunters. The large diameter polymer tip accelerates bullet expansion for rapid trauma upon impact, while the streamlined ballistic profile optimizes the bullet's downrange performance. This load was built specifically for deer hunting and taking down big bucks.

description: Warne Mountain Tech is the lightweight precision scope mounting system. Rings feature stainless steel hardware for "Element Proof" protection. Mil-Spec 65 in/lb., 1/2" tactical nut attachments for securely clamping to the rail. Fits Picatinny and Weaver style mounts and are NATO-STANAG compatible.

name: Rock And Lock Sights
description: The Daniel Defense AR-15 Iron Sight Set is built from the highest quality aircraft grade aluminum and will never let you down. Unlike our belief in the fact “all men are created equal,” AR-15 sights are not. Accuracy and usability depend on quality sights. Consisting of the A1.5 Fixed Rear Sight and Rail-Mounted Fixed Front Sight, this iron sight set will provide a lifetime of service. The A1.5 Fixed Rear Site makes the optimum back-up sight for shooters using today’s most popular reflex optics. The Rail Mounted Fixed Front Sight makes it unobtrusive and snag-free, and allows the operator to facilitate the use of compact weapon-lights forward of the sight, such as the X300, TLR-1, etc.

name: IR-Hunter
description: The IR-HUNTER thermal riflescope is a compact, rugged, powerful thermal optic that enables target acquisition in any light. The turret style controls make nighttime operation easy, even while wearing gloves. USB-C connection port can be used to utilize external power source to extend run time. Record your hunt to share with family and friends with the integrated Digital Video Recorder with SD Card, or via the USB-C port to an external recorder. Engineered to last and built in the US

name: Lawman RHT
description: Speer RHT Ammunition features lead-free bullets that crumble into very small pieces when they hit a metal backstop. These precision-formed bullets are made of sintered powdered copper that's compressed under heat and pressure to form a bullet. Sintered technology means there's no separate jacket that can produce sharp fragments on impact. The tip of each RHT bullet is distinctively marked so range officers can easily tell it from conventional ammunition.

name: Speed-Shok Waterfowl
description: Speed kills ducks and geese. Now it kills even cleaner with redesigned Speed-Shok. Its Catalyst primer and faster burning powders dramatically reduce residue, while its optimized velocities knock birds out of the sky.

name: FAST COG
description: The FAST COG Series Mount was developed to universally accept the Trijicon Combat Optical Gunsight double and triple screw interfaces. It covers both ACOG and VCOG series scopes, placing the optical centerline at 2.05″ above the rail. These scopes are heavily used by military and law enforcement entities who often wear plate carriers, helmets, headsets, and gas masks. This type of gear makes acquiring rapid sight pictures a challenge when using the factory absolute co-witness height mounts. The added height of the FAST COG Series Mount greatly increases threat engagement speed and accuracy under stress while wearing gear

The Civic Duty round defeats barriers as effectively as the R.I.P. and expands 2.5 times its initial diameter after coming into contact with a fluid medium. The Civic Duty round expands to transfer 100 Percent of its energy to the target. The Civic Duty Round retains 99.9 Percent weight inside the intended target without concern of over penetration in CQB situations.

description: AA Diamond Grade is the premier product for the accomplished target shooter. Loaded with super high antimony lead shot that is precision sorted and copper plated. The pattern density and performance with this product is unmatched, yielding solid breaks on the most demanding targets.

Even after all these years, the others continue to follow, lagging far behind the innovative engineering and industry advancements of CCI. Pick up some CCI and see for yourself why this is the Best small caliber target and hunting ammunition that money can buy.

name: American Whitetail
description: Opening day of deer season comes only once a year. Make sure you're ready when the big one steps out and load-up with Hornady American Whitetail ammunition.

name: Xtreme Tactical Scope Ring
description: Xtreme Tactical rings were created specifically for the tactical shooter who puts a premium on less weight and plenty of holding power. The massive strength of a 6-screw ring is combined with lightweight yet thick cross-section aluminum, so from smaller carbines to the most powerful magnums, XTR rings will stand up to years of use and recoil. Xtreme tactical rings work with any Picatinny or Weaver-style base and are ready for the heaviest of scopes, massive recoil and severe usage.

name: Xpert
description: Winchester originally developed Xpert rimfire rounds for plinking on the range. Now years later they still provide the premier 22 rimfire ammunition for all your range day needs.

name: USA Handgun

name: Centerfire Handgun

name: Freight Train

A polymer tip and aerodynamic nose profile maximize downrange energy, while the externally skived nose cavity provides dramatic expansion to drop buck, bears or boars where they stand.

name: RMR Dual Defense Kit
description: The Trijicon Dual Defense Kit combines the legendary RMR and the Suppressor/Optic Height Sight Set into one, easy-to-use kit. This new kit adds speed and precision to your Commercial Variant M17/M18 self-defense, law enforcement, military, competition, or target pistol. The Suppressor/Optic Height sights are engineered to the optimal height so that the iron sight can be seen through the optic lens. Having co-witnessed iron sights helps you quickly acquire the red dot, and if necessary, provides a backup aiming solution.

name: Silvertip Pistol

name: Modern Sporting
description: Talley Modern Sporting Ring is a solution for your Picatinny rail system with a clean appearance. Machined from aircraft grade alloy and has a black anodize finish.

name: American Gunner
description: The American Gunner line of ammunition is a collection of tried-and-true, versatile loads that are popular with shooters for their target shooting, hunting or self-defense needs. Made in the USA with premium components, American Gunner ammunition combines generations of ballistics know-how with modern components and technology. Preliminary offerings feature legendary XTP (eXtreme Terminal Performance) bullets that have been favorites for decades. Designed for hunting, self-defense and law enforcement applications, the XTP bullet is exceptionally accurate.

name: Centerfire Rifle
description: Frontier Cartridge features Hornady bullets and is available in 223 Rem, 5.56 NATO, 300 Blackout and 6.5 Grendel. Applications range from plinking, target shooting and hunting to law enforcement training and self-defense.

name: VOR-TX Rifle
description: Offering double-diameter expansion, maximum weight retention and excellent accuracy, the TSX, Tipped TSX and TSX FN provide maximum tissue and bone destruction, pass through penetration and devastating energy transfer. Multiple grooves in the bullet's shank reduce pressure and improve accuracy. Open on contac & expands as quickly. Nose peels back into four sharp-edged copper petals destroying tissue, bone and vital organs.

name: HEVI-Steel
description: Major Kinetic Energy. The first all-steel shotshell from HEVI-Shot is pushed out at a blistering 1500 fps, compared to competing fast steel loads, which run at 1450fps (12g 3” 1.25oz). This increase in speed delivers 9% more energy at 30 yards and 8% at 40! In short, you will get more knockdown power and fewer crippled birds. Combining higher velocity, a best-in-class wad and precision manufacturing techniques delivers the ultimate in performance. HEVI-Steel hits hard every time!

name: Top Gun Target
description: Even the most challenging targets are no match for consistent, hard-hitting Federal Top Gun. The loads' high-quality lead shot produces even patterns that crush clays.

name: Deep Penetrating X Handgun
description: COR BON's DPX Handgun ammunition exhibits superior performance to all other defensive ammunition on the market. The reason is the homogenous solid copper projectile. Barrier blind is the new terminology for ammunition that outstandingly performs after penetrating a heavy barrier like auto glass or steel. DPX(R) is the only ammunition that maintains 100% of its weight after going through such barriers. The DPX bullet is a 100% solid copper bullet. Internal serration cuts have been added instead of traditional external serrations. These internal serration cuts allow the copper bullet to fully expand making the bullet double diameter with 6 razor sharp pedals.

name: Ballistic SilverTip
description: Winchester's Ballistic SilverTip is a polymer tipped bullet with alloyed lead core, contoured jacket, lubalox (black oxide) coating that produces rapid controlled expansion with massive knockdown and moderate penetration.

name: Select Plus
description: Ultra-high velocity, magnum ammunition is how Roy Weatherby got started in the 1940s. As a young wildcatter, he revolutionized the industry with his fast, hard-hitting loads that were dead-on accurate. Today, those same performance qualities are every bit a part of Weatherby cartridges. Weatherby's move to Wyoming is an exciting step towards the continual opportunity for innovation. The cartridges that paved the way for advancement in ballistics and load development will forever be a solid foundation. Weatherby's intention is a constant progression for ballistic superiority, confidence in developing new and impressive cartridges that perform and meet expectations attached to the Weatherby brand.

name: Centerfire Rifle
description: Frontier Cartridge features Hornady bullets and is available in 223 Rem, 5.56 NATO, 300 Blackout and 6.5 Grendel. Applications range from plinking, target shooting and hunting to law enforcement training and self-defense.

name: Punch Pistol Ammo
description: Most concealed carry permit holders need a bullet designed to stop an attacker. It should work effectively in the carrier's chosen firearm. Punch bullets perform well in the tests that matter most, according to Federal. It delivers penetration and expansion through bare gel and heavy clothing.

name: VOR-TX Long Range Rifle
description: VOR-TX LR is an extreme-distance load combining super-premium components that are assembled with a level of precision never before attained in factory ammunition. The specially engineered LRX bullets loaded in VOR-TX LR are optimized specifically for the cartridge. Unmatched flight characteristics combined with a specially engineered nose cavity that peels back into four cutting petals delivers massive expansion and identical on-game devastation from up close to well past 700 yards.

name: American Gunner
description: The American Gunner line of ammunition is a collection of tried-and-true, versatile loads that are popular with shooters for their target shooting, hunting or self-defense needs. Made in the USA with premium components, American Gunner ammunition combines generations of ballistics know-how with modern components and technology. Preliminary offerings feature legendary XTP (eXtreme Terminal Performance) bullets that have been favorites for decades. Designed for hunting, self-defense and law enforcement applications, the XTP bullet is exceptionally accurate.

name: Hybrid Target
description: The Berger Hybrid Target rifle ammunition is designed for optimal performance in precision long range rifles. The Hybrid target Rifle Bullet is one of the top performing Rifle Bullets in long range precision rifle target style competitions, and for good reason. It is an optimized hybrid design that has a very high BC for its weight and caliber. It is built around a J4 Precision Jacket, which are the most precise and concentric jackets in the world. This means a better balance of the Rifle Bullet, tighter groups, and more hits on target at extended ranges.

name: Defense Dynamics Handgun
description: Serious defense practitioners understand that personal safety requires 24/7 vigilance in all environments. From deep concealment micro pistols and snub-nose revolvers for discrete public carry to defensive rifles and shotguns in the home or on the road. Filling all those magazines and cylinders with reliable-performing defensive ammunition can be expensive, especially when dealing with multiple calibers and chamber gauges. With a focus on jacketed and semi-jacketed hollow points, buckshot, and slugs, the Defense Dynamics line delivers professional results for price-conscious defensive ammunition.

name: Centerfire Rifle
description: Hollow Point projectiles are a great choice for hunting and self defense uses. When you want great value without sacrificing quality and performance, you can rely on Magtech ammunition to deliver results.

name: Maxima Horizontal Rings
description: Maxima Horizontal scope rings are designed" engineered and manufactured by Warne's expert staff in Tualatin" Oregon. Utilizing proprietary sintered steel technology" Maxima Horizontal offers unwavering strength and precision in a stylish" yet traditional form. 4 screw ring caps" along with a unique recoil key and clamp offer easy installation and unrivaled holding strength. With classic lines" and Warne's return to zero guarantee" Maxima Horizontal are the new standard.

name: American Whitetail
description: Opening day of deer season comes only once a year. Make sure you're ready when the big one steps out and load-up with Hornady American Whitetail ammunition.

name: Premier AccuTip-V
description: Expect dynamite results. In varmint calibers, AccuTip-V combines superb flight characteristics and match-grade accuracy with a design optimized for explosive on-game results.

name: Super-X Xpert
description: Consistent, Dependable Performance. Exceptional Quality and Outstanding Performance. Time Proven Dependability. Long-range knock-down. One-Piece Hinged Wad: For consistent, tight patterns and reduced felt-recoil. Famous 209 Primer and Clean Burning Powder Reliable ignition and consistent velocity.

name: Four Hole Skeleton Scope Rings
description: Weaver Four Hole Skeleton Rings are available in heights for just about any shooter and shooting situation. Dressed in matte black and featuring no strip/slip Torx screws, these rings incorporate Weaver's famous Cross-Lock design.

name: Guardian
description: The Radian GUARDIAN Optic Mounting System provides unprecedented protection for your pistol red dot optic. Machined from 7075 aluminum & hard anodized, the design provides top/ front/side impact protection. Optional back-up sights, provide an unobstructed, irons forward sight picture. The STUD-LOK threaded stud/nut mounting interface is the most secure system on the market. This provides much longer thread engagement, greater hold down power, with increased shear resistance. TRU-SEAL eliminates the need for an added sealing plate. Pre-installed O-rings on the mounting screws hold the plate watertight to the slide, sealing out moisture, eliminating corrosion in the mounting threads.

name: Ballistic SilverTip
description: Winchester's Ballistic SilverTip is a polymer tipped bullet with alloyed lead core, contoured jacket, lubalox (black oxide) coating that produces rapid controlled expansion with massive knockdown and moderate penetration.

name: Field Dynamics
description: Fiocchi's Field Dynamics line of centerfire rifle cartridges can be relied on when game is in your crosshairs. Field Dynamics ammunition is comprised of high-quality components to ensure repeatable point-of-impact and optimal terminal performance from a pointed soft-point projectile. Priced to give hunters plenty of opportunity to practice field-rest shooting and be assured of their rifle's zero and point-of-impact across all hunting distances.

name: Match
description: We carefully select every component to ensure uniformity, then load to exacting specifications to provide pinpoint accuracy. Each cartridge is loaded with either Hornady A-MAX bullets, our high-performance boat tail hollow points, or the new, radically superior ELD Match bullets. Stringent quality control ensures proper bullet seating, consistent charges and pressures, optimal velocity, consistent overall length and repeatable accuracy.

name: Black Cloud FS Steel
description: Equipped with the FLITECONTROL FLEX wad, Black Cloud delivers improved pattern density and consistency through both ported and standard waterfowl chokes. The wad's redesigned rear-deploying petals and side-mounted vents stimulate the payload for separation from the wad at the ideal moment for dense, deadly patterns. Plus, the efficient Catalyst lead-free primer and clean-burning, temperature-stable propellant significantly decrease residue in the barrel.

name: Magtech Handgun
description: Full Metal Jacket projectiles are the ideal choice for recreational target shooting and training. When you want great value without sacrificing quality and performance, you can rely on Magtech full metal jacket ammunition to deliver results.

name: Core-Lokt
description: Since 1939, more hunters have relied on Remington Core-Lokt than any other big game ammunition, and rightly so. It's filled more tags on more continents than any other load. Core-Lokt is the original controlled expansion bullet. Its time-proven performance has made it hunting's first choice for over 75 years. The tapered copper jacket is locked to a solid lead core delivering massive 2X expansion, weight retention and consistent on-game results. Available in soft point and pointed soft point versions, and in a range of bullet weights for virtually every centerfire hunting caliber made.

name: Fastfire E
description: The Burris FastFire E is the first fully enclosed emitter red dot in the FastFire series, engineered for pistols, shotguns, and carbines. Built from monolithic machined aluminum, it’s waterproof, shockproof, and fogproof—ready for any environment. The 3.5-MOA dot with an "always on" feature ensures instant readiness, powered by a CR2032 battery with 60,000-hour life. Its aspherical lenses provide a distortion-free, glare-resistant view, enhanced by eight brightness settings (two night vision compatible) and a choice of red or green dot.

name: Laser Boresight
description: The Sightmark Laser Boresight provides the most convenient and accurate method for sighting in rifles and shotguns of all types. Simply chamber the boresight like a regular bullet and a laser dot will show exactly where the rifle is aiming. It’s easy to sight in any scope without firing a single shot. Live fire is only needed to fine tune the weapon being sighted in order to compensate for inconsistencies, such as bullet drop due to distance. Perfect for hunters, competitive shooters and law enforcement, the Sightmark Laser Boresight is sure to take the frustration out of sighting in almost any gun. It’s easy to use and will quickly save both time and money by avoiding prolonged live fire tests at the range; use the extra ammo for honing those shooting skills and for the hunt. A lightweight carrying pouch protects the laser for convenient use in the field. The Sightmark Laser Boresight is available in several calibers and gages for use with all the most popular rifles and shotguns.

name: Super Target
description: Get more performance at the range for less with Winchester Super Target shotshells. Designed to give you outstanding clay-busting performance at the range or in competitions without hitting your wallet as hard as many competitors.

name: Alpha Series Railed Top Cover
description: The Midwest Industries Alpha Series Top Cover brings the AK platform into the 21st century. Machined from 6061 aluminum and given a durable hard coat anodized finish. Patented components allow for an accurate return to zero solution for existing AK firearms. There are no permanent modifications needed for installation on AK Alpha series handguard or firearm allowing user to put firearm back to stock form if desired.

name: Scope Cover
description: Protect your scope during storage with a Burris Scope Cover. The waterproof scope cover prevents corrosion and fogging. Made from super-soft, breathable fabric that shields your scope from dust and dings.

name: Super Target
description: Get more performance at the range for less with Winchester Super Target shotshells. Designed to give you outstanding clay-busting performance at the range or in competitions without hitting your wallet as hard as many competitors.

name: Super Suppressed Rimfire
description: Super Suppressed ammunition is optimized for firearms equipped with suppressors. Offering clean and reliable performance, the Super Suppressed line is engineered for noise reduction, decreased barrel/suppressor fouling and recoil mitigation. Consistent performance and exceptional accuracy is backed by generations of Winchester legendary excellence.

name: Power-Shok Buckshot
description: Whether used for hunting hogs, deer or predators, or for defending one's home, Federal Power-Shok Buckshot loads offer the patterns and terminal performance shooters need. The Triple Plus wad system provides better shot alignment and granulated plastic buffer keeps pellets uniform in shape for tight patterns.

name: Talos Spotting Scope
description: Athlon designed the Talos family of spotting scopes with good optical quality and ease of use in mind. The Talos spotting scope features their fully multi-coated lenses and K9 prisms with silver coating. They bring great clarity and brightness within the reach of all enthusiasts. The light-weight composite chassis is fog proof, waterproof, and filled with nitrogen gas to prevent internal fogging and promote better thermal stability. The product comes with a table-top tripod and soft case allowing you to carry the spotting scope and tripod in one package.

name: VCOG 1-8x28
description: The development of the Trijicon VCOG 1-8x28 riflescope was inspired by requests from the U.S. Military. The result is a tough-as-nails, absolutely precise riflescope that gives users the ability to engage targets from CQB to long range with confidence. Expect superior glass that provides exceptional clarity and color with zero distortion. Choose from MOA or MRAD reticles.

name: FAST Offset Adapter Plate
description: The FAST Offset Optic Adapter Plates place mini red dot sights on the FAST Offset Optic Base. Each plate comes with a specific optic footprint and uses the optic manufacturer’s hardware. Each plate footprint will accept any mini red dot with that footprint pattern. Plates can mount in three positions on the Offset Optic Base (forward cantilever, centered, rearward cantilever) for a customized fit.

name: Super-X Game
description: Consistent, Dependable Performance. Exceptional Quality and Outstanding Performance. Time Proven Dependability. Long-range knock-down. One-Piece Hinged Wad: For consistent, tight patterns and reduced felt-recoil. Famous 209 Primer and Clean Burning Powder Reliable ignition and consistent velocity.

name: MaxxTech Handgun
description: MAXXTech Brass Centerfire Pistol Cartridges gives you unmatched affordability for handgun training and target practice. MAXXTech ammo is manufactured in Eastern Europe to military standards using brass cases, copper jacketed lead bullets, and non-corrosive primers. This is great handgun ammo for high volume shooting as well as having on hand for times of scarcity.

name: ACOG 3.5x35 LED
description: With the Trijicon ACOG 3.5x35 LED riflescope, users can select from six adjustable brightness levels with an “off” between each setting, allowing the user to determine how much to illuminate the reticle - even in transitional lighting. Powered by a single AA battery, the LED ACOG can run for over 12,000 continuous hours (on setting #4). Like all ACOG models, the 3.5x35 LED is designed with a forged 7075-T6 aircraft-grade aluminum alloy housing, making it nearly indestructible.

name: Black Cloud FS Steel
description: Equipped with the FLITECONTROL FLEX wad, Black Cloud delivers improved pattern density and consistency through both ported and standard waterfowl chokes. The wad's redesigned rear-deploying petals and side-mounted vents stimulate the payload for separation from the wad at the ideal moment for dense, deadly patterns. Plus, the efficient Catalyst lead-free primer and clean-burning, temperature-stable propellant significantly decrease residue in the barrel.

name: Rifle
description: Sellier & Bellot ammunition is designed and field-tested to provide shooters and hunters with the widest selection of caliber offerings and the highest performance projectiles on the market today.

name: Supreme THSX 640
description: The Supreme THSX 640 Thermal Hunting Sight combines advanced thermal imaging with exceptional value, delivering precision and reliability in any conditions. Featuring a high performance sensor, it detects heat signatures through smoke, fog, and darkness, providing sharp, customizable visuals with multiple color palettes and reticle options. Its lightweight, rugged design ensures durability and ease of use, while extended battery life supports prolonged hunts. Perfect for hunters the Supreme THSX 640 offers cutting-edge performance at an accessible price.

name: Bear Load Pistol
description: In territory that could prove to be treacherous in a heartbeat, it pays to be ever-vigilant and always ready. Each caliber's specially developed load has been expertly crafted from only the best of components. Hard cast, gas-checked (except 10mm Auto) heavy-for-caliber lead bullets precisely matched with temperature stable powders and primers, all housed in highest quality brass cases. Ever vigilant, always ready.

name: Terminal Ascent
description: Any hunt. Any range. Go beyond what you ever thought possible with Federal Premium Terminal Ascent. Bonded construction penetrates deep on close targets, while the patented Slipstream polymer tip initiates expansion at velocities 200 fps lower than comparable designs. The bullet's long, sleek profile offers an extremely high ballistic coefficient, and its AccuChannel groove technology improves accuracy and minimizes drag.

name: Ring/Base Combo Tikka T3
description: Talley's Lightweight Scope Mount features a unique, one-piece construction extruded from 7000 series alloy and precision CNC-machined to its final design. It has no joint between the scope and the rifle which ultimately provides more strength and durability than most steel rings and bases, but with a lighter overall weight. This model is compatible with Tikka T3 rifles.

name: Varmint
description: HSM Varmint loads employ the same degree of engineering thoroughness as articulate HSM Match ammo. Accuracy again is at the apex of consideration when each component is chosen.

name: Fusion Handgun
description: Fusion Handgun bullets feature the same molecularly fused construction as their rifle counterparts for the toughness, accuracy and terminal performance short-barrel hunters need. The loads' bullet weights and velocities have also been optimized to be lethal on deer without punishing the shooter. 20 rounds per box.

name: G45 Magnifier
description: Regardless of the scenario, the Eotech magnifier provides an unparalleled advantage when transitioning from short-range to long-range shooting.

name: Super-X 100th Anniversary
description: Since 1922, Super-X ammunition has provided exceptional quality and outstanding performance for all types of hunters and shooters who rely on its time-proven dependability backed by legendary excellence.

name: Fusion MSR
description: The modern sporting rifle isn't just some gun. It's a highly adapted hunting machine, and it needs ammunition that's just as customized: Fusion MSR. From primer to projectile, virtually every component is optimized for use in modern sporting rifles and peak ballistic performance through short barrels.

name: American Lever Pistol
description: The Winchester legacy continues with American Lever Range, a product designed for the lever gun enthusiast. Tailored with loads designed for and proven in lever guns, Winchester ensures the guns that won the west continue to win on the range.

name: Condition One Mount
description: The Condition One Modular Mount is Badger Ordnance's answer to a growing demand for modularity in optical platform mounting. With the ever-expanding options available to shooters in the accessory and electro-optic markets, Badger Ordnance saw the need for a mount that can make the most use of precious real estate on rifle platforms while acting as a centralized hub for attachments and not suffering from deflection seen on optics and lasers attached to handguards. The C1 Modular Mount offers the end user four accessory mounting points on the Unimount body both left, right, fore, and aft to suit a wide range of shooter's needs. Unlike traditional ring cap accessories, the C1 accessories can be located in the same height and offset throughout various main mount heights giving the shooter a more consistent offset throughout models. Made from 7075-T6 aluminum Type III Hard Coat Anodized. Weight 5.0oz.

name: American Eagle Handgun
description: The proven line of American Eagle target ammunition provides performance similar to personal defense and competition loads for a familiar feel and realistic practice.

name: BXP Personal Defense Handgun
description: BXP Personal Defense is designed for superior personal defense performance in reliability, expansion and penetration. The X-Point is designed to shield the hollow point through intermediate barriers.

name: Trophy Grade Rifle
description: Manufactured to Nosler's strict quality standards, Trophy Grade ammunition uses Nosler brass and Nosler bullets to attain optimum performance, no matter where your hunting trip takes you. Whether you want your ammunition loaded with AccuBond, Partition Ballistic Tip or , E-Tip. Nosler Trophy Grade Ammunition will have the right load for the right game.

name: Personal Defense Hydra-Shok
description: For time-tested personal defense, choose Federal Premium Hydra-Shok. The bullet's center-post hollow-point design provides optimized penetration with consistent, threat-stopping expansion.

name: Long Range Hybrid Target
description: Our innovative Long Range Hybrid Target (LRHT) Rifle Bullet design provides competitive rifle shooters and long range accuracy enthusiasts a level of precision and consistency unmatched by all other Rifle Bullet manufacturers. They utilize our advanced and proprietary Meplat Reduction Technology (MRT) to produce a homogeneous and repeatable Rifle Bullet profile for the industry’s most consistent ballistic coefficients (BC). This means tighter groups and more hits on target.

name: Superformance
description: Superformance uses progressive propellants that take your favorite V-MAX, NTX, SST, CX, and InterLock, bullets to levels of performance that are simply unattainable with conventional ammunition.

name: Supreme Riflescope
description: The Winchester Supreme quality and performance at the range and in the field ensures you have a dependable optic to trust on your favorite rifle, for your next great adventure on paper or game. Premium lenses transmit the maximum amount of light to your eye through Winchester WINcoat multicoating. This coating not only reduces harsh glare but carrier accurate color while providing a durable scratch resistant coating to exterior lens surfaces. Winchester Supreme riflescopes utilize Second Focal Place (SFP) reticles. This means that the reticle stays the same size throughout the scope's magnification range, while only the image changes size. This allows for the most precise shot placement at any distance, and the reticle will always have the same appearance.

name: Harvest
description: The Barnes Harvest Collection merges Barnes' renowned terminal performance with Sierra's legendary accuracy, providing hunters with unmatched precision and devastating stopping power. With a lineup of calibers chosen and priced to compete in the Whitetail & thin-skinned game market, hunters who aspire to shoot Barnes will now be able to make every shot count. This ammunition is new production, non-corrosive, in boxer-primed, reloadable brass cases. The Sierra GameChanger hunting bullet is the perfect combination of Sierra's legendary match accuracy coupled with deadly penetration. Sierra re-engineered their legendary MatchKing bullet into a hollow point design for quick expansion and fitted it with a transparent green tip for ballistic uniformity. Inside, the GameChanger features a unique construction that utlilizes a special lead alloy surrounded by a tough copper jacket that delivers excellent penetration and expansion at a variety of ranges. It's a GameChanger on any hunt!

name: RMR Dual Defense Kit
description: The Trijicon Dual Defense Kit combines the legendary RMR and the Suppressor/Optic Height Sight Set into one, easy-to-use kit. This new kit adds speed and precision to your Commercial Variant M17/M18 self-defense, law enforcement, military, competition, or target pistol. The Suppressor/Optic Height sights are engineered to the optimal height so that the iron sight can be seen through the optic lens. Having co-witnessed iron sights helps you quickly acquire the red dot, and if necessary, provides a backup aiming solution.

name: Top Mount Base
description: Each Weaver base is machined to tight tolerances for a custom fit. These Aluminum bases offer maximum strength for rings to hold tight.

name: UMC Handgun
description: The Union Metallic Cartridge Company name has been synonymous with some of the finest ammunition made in the United States. Since its beginning in 1867, UMC has blazed a trail of innovation in cartridge-making excellence that continues to this day.

name: Superformance
description: Superformance uses progressive propellants that take your favorite V-MAX, NTX, SST, CX, and InterLock, bullets to levels of performance that are simply unattainable with conventional ammunition.

name: Custom
description: Shooters looking for supreme accuracy and maximum knock-down power turn to Hornady Custom ammunition. Loaded with a variety of Hornady bullets for rifle and pistol, the excellent terminal performance of Hornady Custom ammunition makes it the preferred choice for hunters, competitive shooters, and plinkers.

name: Classic Hunter
description: The Classic Hunter load from Berger represents a top of the line option for this proven, traditional hunting round. Loaded to SAAMI specs for use in factory rifles, you can count on trouble-free operation in your rifle. The temperature stable powders that are used in Berger ammo ensures that you will have the same reliable results in the freezing winter as well as the heat of summer.

name: Tenmile HX
description: The confidence you'll get with the highly versatile Trijicon Tenmile HX by your side. Expect pinpoint precision at long range, all-weather performance you can trust in the middle of nowhere and extremely precise, repeatable adjusters. And the first focal plane MOA Precision Tree reticle allows you to quickly hold for range and wind regardless of magnification. The exposed elevation zero stop allows you to quickly return to zero. Includes Sunshade, Tenebraex Flip Caps, Scopecoat, 3mm and 1.5mm Hex key, repositionable magnification knob and replacement screw, CR2032 battery, quick reference guide.

name: Performance Handgun Ammo
description: Acquire the best Wolf Polyformance Centerfire Handgun Ammunition. If you are in search of top-quality ammo that can serve a range of applications, you have found it. You can enjoy a variety of calibers and styles for any of your shooting needs.

name: Syntech Training Match
description: Make range time matter with all-new Syntech Training Match, loads that offer the same velocity, trajectory and point of impact as equivalent Federal Premium Personal Defense HST and Tactical HST duty ammunition. Like all Syntech offerings, Syntech Training Match features the one-of-a-kind TSJ® projectile, which uses a polymer jacket to eliminate metal fouling and drastically reduce damaging barrel heat and friction. Its Federal-exclusive Catalyst primer provides hot, reliable ignition without lead or other heavy metals, making Syntech Training Match perfect for indoor ranges.

name: American Eagle Rifle
description: American Eagle rifle is quality ammunition loaded for pounding targets. It achieves performance that closely matches comparable Federal Premium loads for the ultimate real-world practice.

name: Power Point
description: Winchester Super-X Power-Point Centerfire Rifle Ammo has proven itself for over 60 years to function reliably in all types of environmental conditions, as well as deliver lethal terminal performance on big game. The exposed lead-tip, Power-Point bullet is constructed with a copper jacket, featuring strategically-placed notches around the jacket mouth, which initiate quick and uniform expansion for massive energy release. A tapered jacket thickness and an alloyed lead core aid to control expansion and retain weight for deep penetration; and a cannelure groove provides for a secure crimp. Super-X Power-Point rifle ammo is manufactured using precision manufacturing processes and high-quality primers, powders, and reloadable brass cases to ensure reliable ignition and consistent accuracy.

name: USA Rifle
description: Winchester USA brand ammunition provides great performance at a value price.

name: Liberty Red Dot
description: Liberty is the all new open reflex red dot sight intended for every day carry and law enforcement duty use on pistols, carbines, and shotguns. Narrower and shorter than our previous Kingslayer series, Liberty is made from tough 7075 aluminum, has a 1x22mm window size and is packed with advanced features that make every day use worry free. Greatly improved battery life, Shake 'N Wake motion sensing illumination, scratch-resistant hardcoat finish-- Liberty checks every box.

name: P.E.P.R. Scope Mount/Ring Combo
description: The streamlined design with QD mount insures 1/4 MOA re-mount capability and allows for use of back up iron sights while maintaining proper eye-relief. It provides adjustment from 5 to 40 MOA without using windage/elevation knobs.

name: Hyperformance Match
description: Fiocchi’s Hyperformance Match cartridges are designed from case head to bullet tip with one mission only—synchronize point-of-aim with point-of-impact at extreme distances...shot after shot. With bullets featuring ± 0.0003 concentricity, weight tolerance to ±0.3 grains, and a profile ensuring a high ballistic coefficient, Hyperformance Match is the new go-to for precision factory target ammunition that stands neck-and-neck with custom handloads.

name: Power-Shok Copper Rifle
description: Practical hunters trust Federal Power-Shok rifle ammunition to deliver reliable on-game performance that fills the freezer at an attractive price. Power-Shok Copper provides that same consistency and value in a non-lead bullet. The loads feature an accurate hollow-point copper-alloy bullet that creates large wound channels, as well as Federal brass and primers. Look for Power-Shok Copper in a variety of the most popular hunting calibers.

name: Superformance
description: Superformance uses progressive propellants that take your favorite V-MAX, NTX, SST, CX, and InterLock, bullets to levels of performance that are simply unattainable with conventional ammunition.

name: Remington Picatinny Base
description: The Badger Ordnance Remington Short Action Scope Rail features an integrated recoil lug and a true MIL STD 1913 slot pattern for additional mounting options. It is machined from 4142 pre-hard (28-32Rc) Steel and Mil Spec Manganese Phosphate finished.

name: Scope Ring Set
description: Riton Scope Rings are machined from 6061-T6 aircraft grade aluminum, these rings are optimal for weight savings and strength.

name: Bear Load
description: Developed as a load to protect hunters while hunting or traveling in bear country, this American-made ammunition is sure to keep you safe with its extreme terminal performance and stopping power. Bear Loads deliver drastically higher velocities when compared to standard loads. Loaded with 15 Brinell Hard Cast Gas-Checked lead bullets, Bear Load ammo is for those situations where you want the maximum penetration to stop game.

name: Power-Shok Rifle
description: The traditional lead-core hunting bullets in Federal Power-Shok rifle loads provide solid accuracy and power at an affordable price. They feature reliable Federal brass, primers and powder and are suited to a wide variety of medium and big games.

name: Rimfire Rings
description: Warne makes the smallest and most stable small bore scope rings available on the market today. These steel rings are designed to fit rimfire rifles which have a 3/8" or 11mm dovetail groove. The rings will mount securely to your firearm with a Torx style T-15 socket cap screw and it is recommend that you use a torque wrench in order to apply the 25 in/lb's of required force for securing the rings. These rings are made from solid steel and features a Matte Black finish.

name: Game Load Upland High Brass
description: Woods or fields. Fur or feathers. Federal Hi-Brass Game Loads have you covered. They are carefully crafted and packed with features that provide reliable, effective performance on a variety of upland game. High-quality round shot is formulated for optimum hardness, improving pattern efficiency. High brass-plated steel head and one-piece wad maximize payloads. Select, high-quality propellant and non-corrosive primer deliver efficient, reliable ignition.

name: Deer Season XP
description: Deer Season XP combines decades of Winchester experience into the perfect choice for deer hunting ammunition. Accuracy, combined with massive bullet impact performance means that Deer Season XP is a great choice for all deer hunters. The large diameter polymer tip accelerates bullet expansion for rapid trauma upon impact, while the streamlined ballistic profile optimizes the bullet's downrange performance. This load was built specifically for deer hunting and taking down big bucks.

name: Six Hole Tactical Rings
description: In the tactical world, performance is mandatory there is no compromise. Whether it's intense training or real life action, you need your zero to stay true. These aircraft-grade aluminum tactical rings feature six points of contact for maximum security and are designed to withstand the most grueling environments imaginable. If you demand the most from your tactical scope, demand Weaver.

name: Cronus BTR Gen 2
description: Whether you want to engage in precision long range target shooting or extreme hunting adventures, the new Athlon Cronus BTR Gen2 scope is just what the doctor ordered. Loaded with desirable features, this scope will not let you down when you need it most. This first focal plane reticle scope features ED glass, Advanced Fully Multi-Coated lenses, Argon purged, a true zero stop and much more. The Cronus BTR Gen2 has been rated as one of the best rifle scopes out there with its new reticle and re-designed battery compartment which makes illumination adjustment easier. The best just got better! If you are looking for the best in rifle scopes, look no further.

name: Backcountry Defense Handgun
description: Hornady introduces Backcountry Defense ammunition. Featuring the DGH (Dangerous Game Handgun) bullet, providing maximum penetration and no deflection, Backcountry Defense delivers peace of mind from your favorite backcountry sidearm.

name: Signature Handgun
description: The Ammo, Inc. Signature Shooting Line balances velocity, accuracy and recoil, our development team carefully analyses every load to help our ballisticians achieve the specific outcome of superiority.

name: AUS Mount
description: Introducing the AUS Mount for magnified optics, from Reptilia. Driven by the request of an end user group, the AUS Mount is the culmination of a 2 year development program. Like the DOT Mount line, the AUS Mount attaches to any M1913 Picatinny rail via the anti-snag spring-loaded nitrided steel clamp and custom bolt mounting system which can be tightened with either a 5/32 hex or a flat blade driver to sit flush with the body of the mount for a low-profile, streamline design. Also like the DOT Mount line, the AUS mount is machined from a single piece of billet 7075-T6 aluminum and is finished with MIL-STD Type III, Class 2, hard anodize coating. The AUS is compatible with all of Reptilia's existing 30mm ROF line, and will be compatible with several new ROF products launching over the coming months. Like all Reptilia products, the AUS Mount is 100% Made in the USA.

name: Bronze Rifle
description: Offers reliable performance for every shooting application, from target shooting to hunting. This long-popular ammunition line makes it possible for hunters and riflemen to enjoy high volume shooting without emptying their wallets. In commercial and military packaging. 20 rounds per box except 50 BMG is 10 rounds per box.

name: Drylok Super Steel
description: Magnum shotcup, Drylok Super Steel Wad, Water resistant, Plated Steel Shot, and Lacquered primer

name: Super Precision Red Dot Mount
description: These mounts are precision machined from a single piece of 7075-T6 high strength aluminum. Utilizing Geissele's update of the classic nut and bolt method" this mount will attach your red dot to your weapon with 1,400 pounds of clamping force, and features 3 shear lugs for maximum rigidity and return to zero.

name: Field Dynamics
description: Shotguns provide a diversity of small- and medium-sized game hunting opportunities. That requires an equally diverse selection of shotshell loads. Fiocchi’s expansive line of Field Dynamics shotshells ensures you will find a load that is just right for every hunt. They are made to the same exacting standards and with the high-quality components typical of Fiocchi’s top-shelf ammunition.

name: Field Dynamics
description: Fiocchi's Field Dynamics line of centerfire rifle cartridges can be relied on when game is in your crosshairs. Field Dynamics ammunition is comprised of high-quality components to ensure repeatable point-of-impact and optimal terminal performance from a pointed soft-point projectile. Priced to give hunters plenty of opportunity to practice field-rest shooting and be assured of their rifle's zero and point-of-impact across all hunting distances.

name: Super Match Rifle
description: Super Match is competition grade ammunition engineered to fit the needs of serious sport shooters. Whether competing on the national stage or training without compromise, Super Match delivers performance in all situations.

name: Precision Hunter
description: Accuracy and terminal performance are the cornerstones of Hornady Precision Hunter factory loaded ammunition. Great care has been given by Hornady engineers to develop superior, match­-accurate hunting loads that allow the ELD­-X bullet to achieve its maximum ballistic potential.

name: HEVI-Teal
description: Hevi-Shot's Hevi-Teal offers a selection of HEVI-Steel shells with smaller pellets, very high pellet counts, more open patterns, and plenty of knockdown power at high velocity, ideal for teal hunting.

name: G33 Magnifier
description: The new G33STS magnifier is shorter and lighter than previous models. The improved mount provides faster transitioning from 3X to 1X. The G33 offers tool free azimuth adjustment, a larger field-of-view and an adjustable diopter for improved, precise focusing.

name: American Rifle Long Action Base
description: Made in the USA, this One-piece Picatinny scope base is designed for use with long action Ruger American Rifles. The MIL-STD Picatinny slot-and-rail spacing accepts Picatinny or Weaver scope rings. One-piece design is precision-machined from billet aluminum. The base is 6" long with a hardcoat anodized finish and includes (4) TORX mounting screws and a T-10 wrench.

name: Power-Shok Copper Rifle
description: Practical hunters trust Federal Power-Shok rifle ammunition to deliver reliable on-game performance that fills the freezer at an attractive price. Power-Shok Copper provides that same consistency and value in a non-lead bullet. The loads feature an accurate hollow-point copper-alloy bullet that creates large wound channels, as well as Federal brass and primers. Look for Power-Shok Copper in a variety of the most popular hunting calibers.

name: Ultralight Scope Mount
description: Aero's Ultralight Scope Mount/Ring Combo frees you from unnecessary bulk. It features a rigid, lightweight design and is compatible with AR type upper receivers with Mil-Spec 1913 Picatinny rails and has a cross-slot keyway that offers excellent recoil protection. Designed for AR type upper receivers. Screw Torque - 15 in-lbs.

name: Hunting
description: Many manufacturers use cheaper, softer shot or lesser grade powder and components to save money. In today's world, there are just too few opportunities to make that "shot of the day" to accept anything but the highest quality hunting shotshells available. NobleSport Hunting shotshells are assembled on the same machines, by the same craftsmen, to the same standards and using the same 21st century technology as NobleSport's world class target shotshells. Only the finest plastic cases, high antimony hard shot, even patterning wads and famous NobleSport 209 primers are used in NobleSport Hunting shotshells.

name: Mini2
description: NOCPIX Mini2 handheld thermal monocular with a 640x512 sensor and 25mm objective lens. Compact, lightweight thermal imaging for scouting and observation.

name: Varmageddon
description: Featuring a highly accurate polymer tip or hollow point combined with a flat base design, Varmageddon products were created for the high-volume varmint shooter who requires the utmost precision. Loaded with Nosler Custom brass, Varmageddon ammunition provides the highest levels of performance for any varmint hunter.

name: Gold Dot Personal Protection
description: Gold Dot has earned the respect of police officers world-wide. No other ammunition combines such a consistent level of high performance. These loads deliver in all situations, which is why you can trust them for home and personal defense. Gold Dot hollow-point bullets are very accurate, tough and unbelievably consistent. 20 rounds per box.

name: Match
description: We carefully select every component to ensure uniformity, then load to exacting specifications to provide pinpoint accuracy. Each cartridge is loaded with either Hornady A-MAX bullets, our high-performance boat tail hollow points, or the new, radically superior ELD Match bullets. Stringent quality control ensures proper bullet seating, consistent charges and pressures, optimal velocity, consistent overall length and repeatable accuracy.

name: ACOG 3.5x35
description: In 1991, the Trijicon ACOG was chosen by the U.S Navy SEALs for testing, then operations. In 1995, German GSG9 SWAT chose the 3.5x35 model for their 550 rifles. Ever since, the ACOG 3.5x35 riflescope has remained a favorite among competitive shooters, law enforcement and freedom-loving civilians everywhere.

name: Standard Rifle
description: Red Army Standard is the ultimate Russian ammo for the true firearms aficionado. From our sealed primer and boat tailed 7.62x39 AK rounds that are considered some of the finest in the world to the new aggressively priced RAS white box packaged steel case ammo that is perfect for a day on the range, every round from Red Army Standard is backed by the reliability our users have come to know and love.

name: RFX 44
description: The RFX44 is packed with industry-leading features while offering a tremendous value to the shooter. A rock-solid machined 6061 aluminum housing, fully multi coated lenses, audible and tactile adjustability, INSTANT-ON activation and closed emitter technology are just a couple of the features that make the RFX 44 a must-have for any shooter.

name: Fusion Tipped
description: Fusion Tipped. The design offers the same great terminal performance as the original bonded soft points but with a polymer tip that increases ballistic coefficient, flattens trajectories, and boosts energy for better accuracy and extended effective range. The product line will be available in offerings ranging from 300 Blackout to 30-06 Sprg. and more.

name: ScopeCap Pro
description: Combining the technology of their ScopeCaps and HexCaps, the Ruggedized ScopeCap Pro features a hexagonal lattice on the front lens when the cover is flipped up, allowing you to see through the optic with minimal obstruction while eliminating downrange reflections. The Cap itself is a simple, rugged, and low-profile solution that protects your scope's lenses and eliminates reflections when not in use. Their signature flipper tab is integral to the ScopeCap and allows for fast, easy removal from your scope's bezel. When doffed, they have a lower profile than traditional flip-style scope caps. Whether flipped up to take a shot or flipped down for ultimate signature reduction, the ScopeCap Pro combines all the features of products you've come to know and love from One Hundred Concepts.

name: Superformance
description: Superformance uses progressive propellants that take your favorite V-MAX, NTX, SST, CX, and InterLock, bullets to levels of performance that are simply unattainable with conventional ammunition.

name: AUS Offset Mount
description: Introducing the AUS OFFSET Mount for miniature red dot sights. Designed as part of our AUS Mount System as a secondary sighting system for rapid target engagement. The AUS Offset Mount is reversible to be used on the left or right side of the AUS Mount via the 4 mounting locations integrated in the AUS Mount body.

name: Pioneer Handgun
description: Bring your lever gun out of retirement—it’s time to experience the superior on-game performance of Barnes Pioneer ammunition. Designed specifically for lever guns and revolvers, this ammo is carefully loaded for terminal performance and delivers massive expansion and weight retention for deeper penetration. Each round is engineered for flawless feeding and cycling from tubular magazine to chamber for lightning-fast follow-up shots.

name: Gold Medal Berger
description: The most sought-after bullets among competitors on the Precision Rifle Series are now loaded into the industry's most trusted factory rifle ammunition. Gold Medal Berger loads feature an advanced boat-tail bullet with a high ballistic coefficient to provide the flattest trajectories, less wind drift and surgical long-range accuracy. To get the most performance out of the bullet designs, these loads use Gold Medal match primers, Federal brass and specially formulated propellant, and they adhere to Federal Premium's strictest specifications for accuracy, pressure and velocity.

name: G43 Magnifier
description: Regardless of the scenario, the Eotech magnifier provides an unparalleled advantage when transitioning from short-range to long-range shooting.

name: Hyperformance Defense
description: Designed with both personal defense and hunting in mind, the XTP bullet has a deep cavity with a pre-cut jacket to initiate rapid expansion and achieves consistent performance across a wide range of velocities to deliver devastating terminal ballistics without overpenetration.

name: C5L Micro
description: The C5L micro is a compact 550 lumen light and green laser powerhouse. This remarkable device maintains the legacy of its predecessor, The C5L an unparalleled benchmark in its category, while embracing a sleeker, more compact design. The C5L micro is a testament to Viridians commitment to excellence, offering an array of industry-leading features that ensure optimal performance and aiming confidence. Equipped with Viridians patented INSTANT-ON technology, the C5L Micro ensures instantaneous activation when needed most. The innovative SAFECharge rechargeable power system eliminates battery worries, guaranteeing that you're always ready for action. The C5L micro also features a built-in Holster Retention Feature (HRF). Whether you prefer concealed or open carry, this feature ensures a secure fit, making the C5L micro an adaptable choice for any shooter. This rail-mounted light and laser combo delivers top-tier performance and reliability in a compact, lightweight package.

name: Picatinny Rail Mount
description: This mount is ideal for installing an optic sight with an RMR footprint on a Picatinny Rail platform.

name: TAC-XPD Defense Handgun
description: The Optimized Solution for Personal and Home Defense. Loaded with the venerable Barnes TAC-XP bullets, TAC-XPD ammunition is engineered and designed to deliver top performance when it is most critical: in life-threatening situations The TAC-XP's all-copper construction and very large, deep hollow-point cavity expand, penetrate and perform more consistently than any personal defense product on the market.

name: Dovetail Base
description: Offered as a one or two-piece system, these all-steel bases provide recoil resistance and feature the dovetail locking system for an ultra-secure, positive lock-on rings.

name: American Gunner
description: The American Gunner line of ammunition is a collection of tried-and-true, versatile loads that are popular with shooters for their target shooting, hunting or self-defense needs. Made in the USA with premium components, American Gunner ammunition combines generations of ballistics know-how with modern components and technology. Preliminary offerings feature legendary XTP (eXtreme Terminal Performance) bullets that have been favorites for decades. Designed for hunting, self-defense and law enforcement applications, the XTP bullet is exceptionally accurate.

name: American Eagle Handgun
description: The proven line of American Eagle target ammunition provides performance similar to personal defense and competition loads for a familiar feel and realistic practice.

name: Rangemaster
description: Recognized for dependability, PPU RANGEMASTER ammunition is manufactured using the highest grade materials and quality production control, ensuring precision performance in accordance with military specifications.

name: Centerfire Handgun
description: PPU handgun ammunition is available in many popular calibers for pistols and revolver style handguns. Our handgun ammunition is brasscased, non-corrosive boxer primed and features our improved bullet designs which result in greater energy performance, bullet expansion and reliability.

name: Mark III Tactical
description: The NcStar Mark III Tactical Series 3-9x42mm Rifle Scope is great for all types of tactical situations. It features green and blue illumination, multiple brightness settings for each color, fully multi coated lenses, improved locking Quick Release mount and Scope Centerline height, raised to AR15's 1.5" scope height.

name: Terminal Ascent
description: Any hunt. Any range. Go beyond what you ever thought possible with Federal Premium Terminal Ascent. Bonded construction penetrates deep on close targets, while the patented Slipstream polymer tip initiates expansion at velocities 200 fps lower than comparable designs. The bullet's long, sleek profile offers an extremely high ballistic coefficient, and its AccuChannel groove technology improves accuracy and minimizes drag.

name: Hyperformance SBR
description: Precision-tuned ammunition designed and formulated for use in short barrels. Each projectile used is specifically selected to deliver the highest ballistic and terminal performance from powders tested and selected to deliver 100% burn, low muzzle flash, diminished report, and high velocity. Safe for use with suppressors and optimized for barrels ranging from 11.5 to 7.5 in length.

name: Maxima Horizontal Rings
description: Maxima Horizontal scope rings are designed" engineered and manufactured by Warne's expert staff in Tualatin" Oregon. Utilizing proprietary sintered steel technology" Maxima Horizontal offers unwavering strength and precision in a stylish" yet traditional form. 4 screw ring caps" along with a unique recoil key and clamp offer easy installation and unrivaled holding strength. With classic lines" and Warne's return to zero guarantee" Maxima Horizontal are the new standard.

name: Super-X Pistol
description: For decades, hunters and shooters have relied on Winchester Super-X handgun ammunition. Best known for time-proven dependability, the rounds offered include a hollow point and lead core for rapid expansion on game, as well as a thin-wall jacket, which reduces engraving forces for improved accuracy.

name: MOS Plate
description: The bespoke mounting plate for the Glock MOS platform allow's the RMS, SMS or Jpoint sights to be mounted so low you can co-witness without suppressor sights.

name: BlazeSeeker
description: Explore the cutting-edge technology of BlazeSeeker monoculars, designed for unparalleled performance and convenience.

name: Tenmile HX
description: The confidence you'll get with the highly versatile Trijicon Tenmile HX by your side. Expect pinpoint precision at long range, all-weather performance you can trust in the middle of nowhere and extremely precise, repeatable adjusters. And the first focal plane MOA Precision Tree reticle allows you to quickly hold for range and wind regardless of magnification. The exposed elevation zero stop allows you to quickly return to zero. Includes Sunshade, Tenebraex Flip Caps, Scopecoat, 3mm and 1.5mm Hex key, repositionable magnification knob and replacement screw, CR2032 battery, quick reference guide.

name: ROF Mount
description: Made in the USA, the Reptilia ROF red dot mount is a drop-in upgrade for magnified scope mounts. It is compatible with Geissele Automatics' Super Precision 30mm optic mount, and adds a mounting point for a red dot to provide a fast, close-range optic to your magnified scope.

name: Red Laser Grip
description: Viridian Weapon Technologies, Grip Laser, Red Laser

name: Condition One Mount
description: The Condition One Modular Mount is Badger Ordnance's answer to a growing demand for modularity in optical platform mounting. With the ever-expanding options available to shooters in the accessory and electro-optic markets, Badger Ordnance saw the need for a mount that can make the most use of precious real estate on rifle platforms while acting as a centralized hub for attachments and not suffering from deflection seen on optics and lasers attached to handguards. The C1 Modular Mount offers the end user four accessory mounting points on the Unimount body both left, right, fore, and aft to suit a wide range of shooter's needs. Unlike traditional ring cap accessories, the C1 accessories can be located in the same height and offset throughout various main mount heights giving the shooter a more consistent offset throughout models. Made from 7075-T6 aluminum Type III Hard Coat Anodized. Weight 5.0oz.

name: Credo HX
description: Whether you're hunting hogs, varmint, or whitetail deer, you need to get on target fast. And few riflescopes let engage with as much speed as the Trijicon Credo HX. Its illuminated reticle gives you a crystal-clear aiming point, excellent light transmission allows for low light hunting, low capped adjusters and an extra-wide field of view offers maximum situational awareness. Includes Bikini caps, Scopecoat, 3mm Hex key, repositionable magnification knob and replacement screw, CR2032 battery, quick reference guide.

name: Blind Side 2
description: Blind Side 2 features Hex steel shot, nickel plated head for improved corrosion resistance and 4-petal wad for better choke response. Loaded with 100% Hex steel shot, you get more pellets on the target, a larger kill zone and more trauma-inducing pellets.

name: Synergy Knob Caps
description: The Burris Synergy Advanced Capped Knob was created to be the ideally suited method for shooters to enhance their scopes. An efficient bit of riflescope gear will make an amazing accessory for the scopes of shooters, and because of the Burris Synergy Advanced Capped Knob, finding a quality bit of scope gear has not been less complicated.

name: UMC Handgun
description: The Union Metallic Cartridge Company name has been synonymous with some of the finest ammunition made in the United States. Since its beginning in 1867, UMC has blazed a trail of innovation in cartridge-making excellence that continues to this day.

name: Gold Dot Personal Protection
description: Gold Dot has earned the respect of police officers world-wide. No other ammunition combines such a consistent level of high performance. These loads deliver in all situations, which is why you can trust them for home and personal defense. Gold Dot hollow-point bullets are very accurate, tough and unbelievably consistent. 20 rounds per box.

name: FAST Magnifier Mount
description: FAST is a series of optic mounts and platforms that provide end users with a quicker sight picture than standard height mounts. A 2.26" optical centerline height provides faster/easier reticle acquisition while wearing electronic EarPro/communications headsets, night vision goggles and gas masks and allows for more rapid visual processing of the battlefield by promoting a heads-up posture.

name: Silvertip Pistol
description: Trusted for decades when it matters most, Silvertip offers the time-proven design with the Power to Defend. Hollow Point, provides maximum stopping power for personal defense scenarios. Engineered Jacket Profile, ensures reliable functioning, precise accuracy and consistent expansion.

name: Speed-Shok Waterfowl
description: Speed kills ducks and geese. Now it kills even cleaner with redesigned Speed-Shok. Its Catalyst primer and faster burning powders dramatically reduce residue, while its optimized velocities knock birds out of the sky.

name: Power-Shok Rifle
description: The traditional lead-core hunting bullets in Federal Power-Shok rifle loads provide solid accuracy and power at an affordable price. They feature reliable Federal brass, primers and powder and are suited to a wide variety of medium and big games.

name: Sight-Rite Laser Bore Sight
description: Get meticulous accuracy with the most exacting tolerance specifications in the sighting industry. Sight-Rite is SME's precision machined caliber specific sighter that delivers unparalleled results. It is precision machined from brass casing for optimum accuracy and has a high output laser. Included are three (3) button cell batteries.

name: S&W Revolver Red Dot Mount
description: Midwest Industries red dot mount for most Smith & Wesson K, L, N and X frame revolvers with three holes on the top strap. Anodized aluminum, black.

name: Super Target
description: Get more performance at the range for less with Winchester Super Target shotshells. Designed to give you outstanding clay-busting performance at the range or in competitions without hitting your wallet as hard as many competitors.

name: Rifle
description: Sellier & Bellot ammunition is designed and field-tested to provide shooters and hunters with the widest selection of caliber offerings and the highest performance projectiles on the market today.

name: Minimalist Bundle
description: The ready-made Optic Plate and Sight combo offers a one stop shop mounting solution, while increasing window visibility and providing a simple back up sight picture. XS OR Sights for Glock pistols are low-profile BUIS that do not obstruct your field of view. XS OR sights eliminate the need for height calculations, giving you the perfect co-witness out of the box. Designed for strength and reliability, the XS Optic Plates for Glock MOS pistols are available for ACRO footprint optics, providing a secure and seamless mounting solution.

name: Steel Tyme Laser Cartridge Kit
description: LaserLyte Steel Tyme laser cartridge kit. A 9mm laser training cartridge paired with a reactive laser target for dry-fire practice with your own pistol.

name: Field Dynamics
description: Shotguns provide a diversity of small- and medium-sized game hunting opportunities. That requires an equally diverse selection of shotshell loads. Fiocchi’s expansive line of Field Dynamics shotshells ensures you will find a load that is just right for every hunt. They are made to the same exacting standards and with the high-quality components typical of Fiocchi’s top-shelf ammunition.

name: HD Night Sights
description: The HD Night Sights were specifically created to address the needs of tactical shooters. They are a self-luminous, three-dot night sight set that features a highly visible photoluminescent paint outline to quicken sight acquisition, along with a "U" notch rear sight that's angled and serrated to reduce glare and aid in front-sight focus. The Tritium gas lamps are contained within protective aluminum cylinders and have additional silicone rubber cushioning. Each Trijicon tritium lamp is capped with a sapphire jewel that helps evenly distribute the light and also acts as an additional layer of protection from puncture and cleaning solvents.

name: USA Handgun
