description: Invest in deep penetration with Winchester USA Centerfire Handgun Ammunition. Now you can hit your targets harder with less noise. This harder hit will show you the difference between making a target wobble and making it fall down.

name: Argos
description: Designed and manufactured to provide exceptional performance and durability the Argos optic mount is fully machined from 7075-T651 plate, and anodized with type 3 hardcoat to accommodate years of abuse.

name: Handgun
description: Full Metal Jacket projectiles are the ideal choice for recreational target shooting and extended training sessions at the range. When you want great value without sacrificing quality and performance, you can rely on Sellier & Bellot full metal jacket ammunition to deliver reliable results.

name: X1 Primal
description: The X1 Primal 3-9x40 is assembled in an EP-Level Clean Room. Features crystal-clear HD glass, integrated throw lever, fully multi-coated lenses, 1" tube and capped, zero resettable turrets.

name: Weatherby Picatinny Base
description: Picatinny bases for Weatherby rifles.

name: Black Rifle
description: Hornady BLACK ammunition features versatile loads optimized for excellent performance from America's favorite guns. Loaded with legendary Hornady bullets, Hornady BLACK ammunition is designed to fit, feed and function in a variety of platforms. Direct impingement, gas piston, suppressed, unsuppressed, inertia, bolt, pump, supersonic, subsonic, rifle, mid-length, carbine or pistol Hornady BLACK ammunition delivers superior performance for a variety of applications. Made in the USA.

name: Game Load Upland High Brass
description: Woods or fields. Fur or feathers. Federal Hi-Brass Game Loads have you covered. They are carefully crafted and packed with features that provide reliable, effective performance on a variety of upland game. High-quality round shot is formulated for optimum hardness, improving pattern efficiency. High brass-plated steel head and one-piece wad maximize payloads. Select, high-quality propellant and non-corrosive primer deliver efficient, reliable ignition.

name: Otis LT
description: The ATN OTS LT thermal monocular has been completely redesigned, it is compact and a lightweight thermal handheld scanner. Powered by our new Obsidian LT Core and Cutting Edge sensors for sharp, crisp infrared monocular images in White Hot or Black Hot. With a long-lasting battery life of 10+ hours and simple, easy to use controls, give you the advantage for game detection/recovery and Search and Rescue operations will be quicker and more efficient.

name: AA Shotshell
description: Winchester is continuing a shotshell manufacturing pedigree of quality and innovation that extends back to 1886. From the 19th through the 20th, and now into the 21st century, Winchester has led the industry in ground-breaking developments in shotshell loads and components. These shotshells are designed to give you outstanding clay-busting performance in sporting clays, trap and skeet - all at a highly competitive, value price. AA Super Sporting Clay Target Loads are designed for competition or recreational sport clay shooting.

name: Personal Defense Hydra-Shok
description: For time-tested personal defense, choose Federal Premium Hydra-Shok. The bullet's center-post hollow-point design provides optimized penetration with consistent, threat-stopping expansion.

name: Signature Rifle
description: The perfect ammo for hunting out in nature or at the range. You will not find a higher quality, better performing line of rifle ammo than the Signature Ammo, Inc. rifle line. Balancing velocity, accuracy, and recoil, our development team carefully analyses every load to help our ballisticians achieve the specific outcome of superiority.

name: XTR Base
description: The Xtreme Tactical (XTR) base offers the perfect mounting solution for precision shooters

name: Maxima Base
description: The Maxima Steel Bases are modeled around the popular Weaver design. The low profile of the Maxima Steel Bases give your firearm a sleek look. When used in conjunction with Warne Maxima QD Rings, the shooter is able to utilize the open sights by looking over the top of the bases without sacrificing the normal shooting position behind the firearm. Maxima Bases offer a full width recoil slot in each base. This feature allows the recoil control keys of Warne Rings to attain maximum bearing surface.

name: RMSd
description: An all new parallax free, Hard Dip Coated - Acrylic optic, which can withstand up to ten times greater shock impact than products using regular glass lenes. Unlike many competing products, the RMSd is designed without a red reflective filter on the lens to ensure minimal visual signature. The sight body is made from aerospace-grade aluminum and has an anodized matte black finish. Variable intensity drive circuit that senses target light levels and controls LED output giving optimum visibility of the dot against the target. The RMSd fits all mounts readily available for the SMS. The RMSd has side accessible battery drawer that allows you to change the battery without having to unmount the sight. The Glass Edition has an all new scratch-resistant ultra clear Glass Lens, and upgraded electronics with improved battery contacts with the same frame and low-profile that allows you to co-witness with standard iron sights.

name: Field Dynamics
description: Fiocchi's Field Dynamics line of centerfire rifle cartridges can be relied on when game is in your crosshairs. Field Dynamics ammunition is comprised of high-quality components to ensure repeatable point-of-impact and optimal terminal performance from a pointed soft-point projectile. Priced to give hunters plenty of opportunity to practice field-rest shooting and be assured of their rifle's zero and point-of-impact across all hunting distances.

name: Telos
description: Pulsar Image Boost gives Telos thermal imaging the highest level of detail, clarity and contrast with a set of original image processing algorithms. Telos thermal monoculars render complex scenes in a wide range of halftones with evenly emitting low-contrast objects, such as the sky, grass and water surfaces. Software detailing and sharpening of objects at different distances makes the thermal image highly informative. User mode saves selected brightness settings. Includes battery and carry case.

name: Signature LRF
description: Well known for integrating powerful rangefinders into optics, Burris introduces the Signature LRF for fast and precise ranging from 5 to 2600 yards. Ultra-sharp HD glass and an easy-to-read display offer comfortable glassing and blazing fast ranging for both hunters and shooters.

name: Custom Rifle
description: Shooters looking for supreme accuracy and maximum knock-down power turn to Hornady Custom ammunition. Loaded with a variety of Hornady bullets for rifle and pistol, the excellent terminal performance of Hornady Custom ammunition makes it the preferred choice for hunters, competitive shooters, and plinkers.

name: PLxC
description: Improving on its predecessor, the fully redesigned PLxC 1-8x24mm Compact Rifle Scope has a 9.28-inch OAL and weighs only 16.95 oz. It features premium-grade Japanese ED lenses for superior light transmission, color correctness, and image clarity. Combined with its ultra-wide field of view (121ft @ 100yd) and forgiving eye relief, this scope is capable of exceptional performance from close quarters to long-range. This compact low power variable optic (LPVO) is the perfect do-it-all scope for your next build.

name: Vapor Picatinny Rail
description: Warne Vapor rails are designed to offer shooters an affordable and reliable mounting platform manufactured for your specific firearm. Fits Picatinny & weaver style rings and are NATO-STANAG compatible.

name: Defender Pistol
description: Ammunition for personal defense. Engineered to maximize terminal ballistics as defined by the demanding FBI test protocol, which simulates real world threats. The proprietary bonding process welds lead and jacket together to work as a unit, controlling expansion and providing superior retained weight upon impact. Six segment jacket design promotes consistent and programmed expansion at a variety of impact velocities.

name: Expander Slug
description: Remington Premier Expander Slug ammunition features the Barnes TSX slug for hard hitting performance. These revolutionary slugs from Barnes are made of 100% copper and contain no lead. When the slug expands, four razor-sharp cutting petals are created, allowing the slug to penetrate farther through tough bone and tissue. These slugs usually retain 100% their original weight, making them a superb choice for hunting.

name: USA Rimfire
description: With a reputation steeped in tradition, Winchester has earned the moniker 'The American Legend' by delivering on their commitment to innovation & excellence in everything Winchester does.

name: RMR Dual Illumination
description: The Dual-Illuminated RMR uses fiber optics and tritium to illuminate the reticle. Fiber optics collect ambient light, automatically adjusting the reticle brightness. In situations with no (or low) light, the tritium illuminates the reticle. This version is popular with shooters who prefer a battery-free solution.

name: DOGTAG Optic Plate
description: Optic Plates made by Calculated Kinetics are a great upgrade from the factory provided plates. Tighter tolerances, better screws, and a built-in deflection table to reduce carbon by 75% why would you get any other optic plate?

name: AMS
description: The Advanced Mini Sight is the first enclosed emitter optic from SHIELD that retains Shield Sight's famous SHIELD footprint, offering co-witness capability with standard height irons sights.

name: Black Rifle
description: Hornady BLACK ammunition features versatile loads optimized for excellent performance from America's favorite guns. Loaded with legendary Hornady bullets, Hornady BLACK ammunition is designed to fit, feed and function in a variety of platforms. Direct impingement, gas piston, suppressed, unsuppressed, inertia, bolt, pump, supersonic, subsonic, rifle, mid-length, carbine or pistol Hornady BLACK ammunition delivers superior performance for a variety of applications. Made in the USA.

name: Bolt Action Mount
description: Trijicon's Bolt Action Mount w/ Trijicon Q-LOC Technology is designed to keep the optic as low as possible for hunting and long range precision rifle applications. Featuring a Mil-Spec drop test rated 6061-T6 aluminum design and an easy to use one handed toolless mounting system. The spring-loaded design allows for constant retention and maintaining of zero even if the knobs are not tightened.

name: Varmint Express
description: Hornady Varmint Express ammunition is designed around the hard-hitting performance of our famous V-MAX bullet. Polymer tipped V-MAX bullets deliver match accuracy, high ballistic coefficients, wind defying trajectories, and rapid fragmentation upon contact. Each Varmint Express offering is loaded with high quality cases and carefully selected propellant and primers that are chosen to provide the best performance in each individual load.

name: MOS Plates
description: The MOS system allows you to mount the sight you want quickly and easily using only a few tools. Changing the sight is just as easy; just remove the old sight, remove and reinstall the correct adapter plate, and mount the new sight.

name: Streak Handgun Ammo
description: Streak Visual Ammunitions exclusive and patented technology allows the shooter to visually see the projectiles path towards its target. Streak rounds are non-incendiary, meaning they don't generate heat and thus are safe to use in environments where traditional tracers are prohibited and can be a serious fire hazard. For indoor range use and nighttime shooting.

name: Syntech Range
description: Experience a cleaner way to shoot. The exclusive polymer coating in Syntech range ammunition prevents harsh metal-on-metal contact between the bullet and bore, eliminating copper and lead fouling. Combined with clean-burning powders and the Catalyst lead-free primer, Syntech loads keep your gun cleaner, longer, so you can shoot more—and shoot better.

name: UMC Handgun
description: The Union Metallic Cartridge Company name has been synonymous with some of the finest ammunition made in the United States. Since its beginning in 1867, UMC has blazed a trail of innovation in cartridge-making excellence that continues to this day.

name: Signature Handgun
description: The Ammo, Inc. Signature Shooting Line balances velocity, accuracy and recoil, our development team carefully analyses every load to help our ballisticians achieve the specific outcome of superiority.

name: Varmint HV
description: The Winchester Varmint High Velocity (HV) load offers small game hunters a high performing cartridge that may also be used for target shooting or plinking.

name: VOR-TX Long Range Rifle
description: VOR-TX LR is an extreme-distance load combining super-premium components that are assembled with a level of precision never before attained in factory ammunition. The specially engineered LRX bullets loaded in VOR-TX LR are optimized specifically for the cartridge. Unmatched flight characteristics combined with a specially engineered nose cavity that peels back into four cutting petals delivers massive expansion and identical on-game devastation from up close to well past 700 yards.

name: Picatinny Rail Remington 700 Long Action
description: Talley's Picatinny Base is constructed of 7075-T6 aluminum with matte black finish. This model is compatible with Remington 700 long action rifles.

name: Shotgun Optic Mount
description: With the Multi Optic Plate Pattern, this optic mount is going to breathe new life and joy into your shotguns that don't get enough attention. You'll now be able to use a huge variety of red dot sights with the following footprints: RMR, Docter/Noblex, C-More, Romeo 1/2/Pro, and Shield RMS. And of course, they include all the hardware you'll need as well. Shotgun Compatibility: Benelli: M2 Tactical, M3, M4 (not compatible w/ M4 Multirail), Vinci Tactical, Super Vinci, Super Black Eagle II and III, Stoeger: M3000 Series and Franchi: Affinity 3.5.

name: Ultralight Scope Mount
description: Aero's Ultralight Scope Mount/Ring Combo frees you from unnecessary bulk. It features a rigid, lightweight design and is compatible with AR type upper receivers with Mil-Spec 1913 Picatinny rails and has a cross-slot keyway that offers excellent recoil protection. Designed for AR type upper receivers. Screw Torque - 15 in-lbs.

name: Magtech Handgun
description: Full Metal Jacket projectiles are the ideal choice for recreational target shooting and training. When you want great value without sacrificing quality and performance, you can rely on Magtech full metal jacket ammunition to deliver results.

name: Rifle
description: Sellier & Bellot ammunition is designed and field-tested to provide shooters and hunters with the widest selection of caliber offerings and the highest performance projectiles on the market today.

name: Bear Load Pistol
description: In territory that could prove to be treacherous in a heartbeat, it pays to be ever-vigilant and always ready. Each caliber's specially developed load has been expertly crafted from only the best of components. Hard cast, gas-checked (except 10mm Auto) heavy-for-caliber lead bullets precisely matched with temperature stable powders and primers, all housed in highest quality brass cases. Ever vigilant, always ready.

name: HEVI-Bismuth Pest Control
description: Be prepared to take out damaging pests with new CCI HEVI-Bismuth centerfire handgun shotshells. They’re built on CCI’s proven centerfire handgun shotshell design but are loaded with the Catalyst lead-free primer and 9.6 g/cc HEVI-Bismuth pellets.

name: Precision Match Rifle
description: Precision Match, engineered for precision at extreme distances, features exceptionally low standard deviations and extreme variations due to Barnes' exacting manufacturing and quality standards. Precision Match rounds are loaded with a match grade OTM (Open Tip Match) BT projectile featuring a long boat tail and high B.C. As an additional bonus, scan the QR code located on the back of each box to view Doppler radar generated drop tables specific to each load.

name: Hi-Brite
description: Easily user installed without the need for gunsmithing or special tools, the Guide Rod Laser is constructed with rugged, precision components including aircraft-grade aluminum and genuine Wolff springs.

name: Black Rifle
description: Hornady BLACK ammunition features versatile loads optimized for excellent performance from America's favorite guns. Loaded with legendary Hornady bullets, Hornady BLACK ammunition is designed to fit, feed and function in a variety of platforms. Direct impingement, gas piston, suppressed, unsuppressed, inertia, bolt, pump, supersonic, subsonic, rifle, mid-length, carbine or pistol Hornady BLACK ammunition delivers superior performance for a variety of applications. Made in the USA.

name: ROF Mount
description: Made in the USA, the Reptilia ROF red dot mount is a drop-in upgrade for magnified scope mounts. It is compatible with Geissele Automatics' Super Precision 30mm optic mount, and adds a mounting point for a red dot to provide a fast, close-range optic to your magnified scope.

name: Ballistic SilverTip
description: Winchester's Ballistic SilverTip is a polymer tipped bullet with alloyed lead core, contoured jacket, lubalox (black oxide) coating that produces rapid controlled expansion with massive knockdown and moderate penetration.

name: Recon Scope Mount
description: The AD-RECON-S mount is made for putting high power glass onto a flattop style AR-10, Bolt Action Rifle , and Lever Action Rifles. It is precision machined from 6061 T6 aluminum and finished in hard coat T3 Mil-Spec anodize.

name: Instant Target Sight
description: Micro Dot Sight Built on True Strength Platform, Shockproof, Fogproof and Rainproof. Versatile Super-compact Body - a Mere 2.6" in Length. Clear and Sharp Target Dot 4.0 MOA at 100Yds. Instant Target Aiming (ITA) and Instant Lock On Target to Enhance Shooting Accuracy and Performance. Red or Green Dot Illumination with Intensity Adjustment to Adapt to Any Environment. Great Field of View and Unlimited Eye Relief for a Wide Variety of Pistol, Shotgun and Rifle Applications. Perfect Co-witness with A2 Standard Iron Sights Using a 1/2" Riser or 1/3 Co-witness with a 3/5" Riser. Integral Mounting Base with Innovative Quick Detach Lever Lock for Rapid Deployment on Any Picatinny Rail

name: Super Target
description: Get more performance at the range for less with Winchester Super Target shotshells. Designed to give you outstanding clay-busting performance at the range or in competitions without hitting your wallet as hard as many competitors.

name: DOGTAG Optic Plate
description: Optic Plates made by Calculated Kinetics are a great upgrade from the factory provided plates. Tighter tolerances, better screws, and a built-in deflection table to reduce carbon by 75% why would you get any other optic plate?

name: Range Dynamics Handgun
description: Fiocchi's Range Dynamics is ideal for a day at the local club with family and friends, practicing for your next competition, or headed to a training course to develop your skills.

name: AA Shotshell
description: Winchester is continuing a shotshell manufacturing pedigree of quality and innovation that extends back to 1886. From the 19th through the 20th, and now into the 21st century, Winchester has led the industry in ground-breaking developments in shotshell loads and components. These shotshells are designed to give you outstanding clay-busting performance in sporting clays, trap and skeet - all at a highly competitive, value price. AA Super Sporting Clay Target Loads are designed for competition or recreational sport clay shooting.

name: SRO
description: The Trijicon SRO (Specialized Reflex Optic) is designed with a maximized field of view and a clean, crisp red dot that deliver improved pistol accuracy in competitive-shooting and target-shooting applications. It’s also engineered with Trijicon’s legendary durability, so it can withstand abuse on and off the range. The wide field of view and clean, crisp dot make it easy for users to find and track the dot in both target and competitive shooting applications, helping improve shooting accuracy and speed. Every SRO features both manual and automatic LED brightness modes. Additionally, a top-loading CR2032 battery provides a 3-year battery life (at setting 4 of 8).

name: Tru-Brite Scope
description: The Tru-Brite scopes offers the ideal combination of clarity, precision, and speed for a variety of hunting applications

name: GLx MD-21S
description: The GLx MD-21s is a high-performance micro dot optic, built for superior agility and precision from close-quarters to intermediate range. This red dot features an advanced solar failsafe system, supplementing your power supply to ensure the optic operates with maximum runtime.

name: Magtech Handgun
description: Full Metal Jacket projectiles are the ideal choice for recreational target shooting and training. When you want great value without sacrificing quality and performance, you can rely on Magtech full metal jacket ammunition to deliver results.

name: Fusion Rifle
description: Fusion was the first rifle ammunition specifically built for deer hunting and it's still the best, offering the largest expansion and highest weight retention in head-to-head comparisons against the competition.

name: Premium Vital-Shok Buckshot
description: The Federal Premium Vital-Shok Buckshot shells are designed with patented spiral stacking process with a plastic shot cup and buffer. This process ensures a tight pattern and high velocity impact. Shot is copper plated and offers power, quality and accuracy for medium game hunts.

name: HEVI-XII
description: Density Matters. If you throw a ping pong ball and golf ball at the same velocity, which will travel further and hit harder? This is the core of what our 12 g/cc tungsten shot is all about: Hit harder at farther distance. HEVI-XII is 53.8% more dense than steel, which translates to double the downrange energy! This allows you to drop down 3 shot sizes for the same lethality. This gives you 28% more devastating pellets on target. More kills. Fewer Cripples. Better Stories. Pack in with HEVI-XII and walk out carrying extra weight.

name: SMS
description: World's original, smallest, lightest, toughest mini day / night sight for all military, law enforcement and sporting small arms. With over 100,000 delivered to date, Shield's Mini Sight has a proven track record. The SMS was designed originally for use with pistols and has since evolved into an all round combat optic, used intensively in war zones all over the globe. Over 15,000 units are in use by the British regular army and Special Forces, as well as US, Australian, New Zealand Special Forces and other NATO forces. Also used by competitive sports men and women across the globe. Shoot early with both eyes open, hit early whilst providing large peripheral vision. It continues to excel in competition shooting and self defense and is a great choice for any and all aiming needs.

name: UMC Handgun
description: The Union Metallic Cartridge Company name has been synonymous with some of the finest ammunition made in the United States. Since its beginning in 1867, UMC has blazed a trail of innovation in cartridge-making excellence that continues to this day.

name: Outfitter
description: From the backcountry to the back-forty, trust your hunt to Outfitter ammunition. Featuring corrosion resistant nickel-plated cases that are sealed watertight and topped with the accurate and rugged CX bullet, Outfitter ammunition is designed to perform under the toughest conditions.

name: SRO
description: The Trijicon SRO (Specialized Reflex Optic) is designed with a maximized field of view and a clean, crisp red dot that deliver improved pistol accuracy in competitive-shooting and target-shooting applications. It’s also engineered with Trijicon’s legendary durability, so it can withstand abuse on and off the range. The wide field of view and clean, crisp dot make it easy for users to find and track the dot in both target and competitive shooting applications, helping improve shooting accuracy and speed. Every SRO features both manual and automatic LED brightness modes. Additionally, a top-loading CR2032 battery provides a 3-year battery life (at setting 4 of 8).

name: RCR
description: An extremely rugged and durable closed emitter optic which meets the demanding standards for military and law enforcement applications. The Trijicon RCR represents the next evolution of the Trijicon RMR and is designed to be as durable as the legendary Trijicon ACOG, while also improving precision and accuracy with any style or caliber of firearm in any type of environment. The RCR can withstand direct impacts and survive in the harshest environments, while still providing enhanced accuracy and an excellent field of view. The RCR does this while not requiring additional or new plates to be used as it works with the current RMR bolt pattern and direct mounts without the use of a dovetail.

name: AEMS Mount
description: The AD-AEMS mount is designed as a QD replacement mount for the Holosun AEMS Red Dot. The mount is precision machined from 6061 T6 aluminum and finished in hard coat T3 Mil-Spec anodize and features the Patented QD Auto Lock Lever system to accommodate both in spec and out of spec rail systems.

name: Sight-Rite Muzzle Laser Bore Sight
description: This Sight-Rite Muzzle Laser Bore Sighter is a versatile system that works with all calibers from .17 to .50. It features a unique adaptor kit which provides stable alignment, producing accurate bore sighting results. The dual o-ring system will not damage the barrel end and there is no metal to metal contact. A protective tube and batteries are included.

name: Super Suppressed Rifle
description: The use and ownership of suppressors across the United States continues to grow in popularity. Winchester introduces a new line of ammunition called Super Suppressed made specifically for shooting through firearms outfitted with a suppressor.

name: Hyperformance Defense
description: Designed with both personal defense and hunting in mind, the XTP bullet has a deep cavity with a pre-cut jacket to initiate rapid expansion and achieves consistent performance across a wide range of velocities to deliver devastating terminal ballistics without overpenetration.

name: Buckshot
description: Whether you use your shotgun for defense, hunting or competitive shooting, choose from the wide variety of Sellier & Bellot buckshot loads to give you the edge in any shooting scenario. Tight downrange patterns combined with excellent stopping power make Sellier & Bellot the perfect choice for your next hunting adventure.

name: Vudu
description: The EOTech line of Vudu rifle scopes is where durability, precision and versatility meet. Our rifle scopes are engineered and constructed to meet the most rugged demands of the serious precision shooter. Starting from a solid piece of aircraft-grade aluminum and finished with the highest quality AR-coated (HD) glass and surgically precise turret systems, the Vudu line of rifle scopes lets you deliver that critical shot when it matters most.

name: Spectrum 4K-Mini
description: The Spectrum 4K-Mini digital day & night vision scope from AGM utilizes practically all features but in smaller and lighter body. Spectrum 4K-Mini based on an advanced high-resolution 38402160 detector, which works in conjunction with a high quality 1920x1080 OLED display. The display allows users the ability to switch from a semi-circular interface to a rectangular interface. Also added the ability to switch the image refresh rate to 100 Hz, that enhances image fluidity, particularly useful for fast-moving targets. The Spectrum 4K-Mini is one step in the continuous evolution of full color digital electro-optics. Powered by built-in rechargeable battery and one additional replaceable 18650 batteries. The 8hr battery life supplies users with more than enough time behind the eyepiece during hunting season. The internal storage capacity, which comes in at a robust 32GB, which will come in handy when recording in high resolution.

name: Fullfield E1
description: The Burris Fullfield E1 is the classic size for American hunters in all sorts of terrain and conditions. The riflescope is resistant to a lifetime of field use, heavy recoil and harsh vibration. Features finger-adjustable windage and elevation turrets, Turret indications always reflect a change in the point of impact, separated power ring and eyepiece design accepts flip-up lens covers, Hi-Lume multicoating aids in low-light performance and glare elimination, 1" body tube and the Ballistic Plex E1 reticle.

name: Vudu
description: The EOTech line of Vudu rifle scopes is where durability, precision and versatility meet. Our rifle scopes are engineered and constructed to meet the most rugged demands of the serious precision shooter. Starting from a solid piece of aircraft-grade aluminum and finished with the highest quality AR-coated (HD) glass and surgically precise turret systems, the Vudu line of rifle scopes lets you deliver that critical shot when it matters most.

name: Buckshot
description: Whether you use your shotgun for defense, hunting or competitive shooting, choose from the wide variety of Sellier & Bellot buckshot loads to give you the edge in any shooting scenario. Tight downrange patterns combined with excellent stopping power make Sellier & Bellot the perfect choice for your next hunting adventure.

name: Quad Lock Detachable Rings
description: Two straps and four screws provide added gripping power for these lightweight, all-aluminum rings. Thumbscrews for quick detach.

name: Centerfire Pistol Shotshells
description: Great for close range pest control. Packed in reusable boxes of ten shotshells.

name: Pow'rBall
description: The Pow'RBall is a gilding metal jacket filled with a lead core that's shaped into a Patented V shape, then capped with a round polymer ball which is crimped and held in place by the copper jacket. During flight, the polymer ball disperses air around the bullet making it more aerodynamic, which improves ballistics. The ball also enhances feeding in auto pistols. During impact the polymer ball delays expansion allowing it to penetrate several inches before it is pushed out of the way exposing the lead V shape cavity, causing the bullet to fully expand properly. Another benefit of the polymer ball is that it protects the integrity of the hollow point by not allowing clothing or other material to plug up the hollow point cavity causing it to fail to expand.

name: Bronze Pistol
description: The same quality and dependability built into our Starfire ammunition is incorporated throughout our extensive line of PMC training ammunition and standard hollow point or soft point ammunition. All PMC cartridges must pass through the rigorous inspection of our electronic powder check station. This station accurately measures the propellant charge in each round. If the propellant in any cartridge varies by a tiny amount - just two tenths of one grain - the system stops and that cartridge is discarded. 50 rounds per box except where noted.

name: Veracity
description: The Burris Veracity's small enough for driven hunts and stalking in timber, but 10x magnification offers enough zoom for most longer range hunts as well. The compactness and low weight make it very popular for lightweight rigs. The 2-10x uses the Burris M.A.D. Knob System, which allows for custom etched knobs or quickly switching to available exposed knobs. It ships with low capped knobs. This model ships with both the covered and exposed elevation caps. The scope features Ballistic Plex E1 FFP, 5-times zoom system, 30mm tube and front focal plane reticle design allows the reticle size to increase or decrease as magnification is increased or decreased; trajectory compensation is always correct and proportional for the selected power setting.

name: MK2 Red Dot Mount
description: Engineered for precision and built to last, the MK2 series elevates your shooting experience with unmatched reliability and style. These MK2 Mounts are designed for shooters seeking a robust and refined scope mounting solution. Featuring a next-generation design, these mounts combine enhanced functionality with a premium aesthetic.

name: VOR-TX Rifle
description: Offering double-diameter expansion, maximum weight retention and excellent accuracy, the TSX, Tipped TSX and TSX FN provide maximum tissue and bone destruction, pass through penetration and devastating energy transfer. Multiple grooves in the bullet's shank reduce pressure and improve accuracy. Open on contac & expands as quickly. Nose peels back into four sharp-edged copper petals destroying tissue, bone and vital organs.

name: Core-Lokt Copper
description: Deadly Core-Lokt Copper. Dependable expansion, proven weight retention, and drop-dead accuracy. The performance you’ve come to know and expect from Core-Lokt, now guaranteed with a lead-free bullet. Rigid construction from high-strength copper ensures Core-Lokt Copper’s monometal bullet dispatches big game with true Deadly Mushroom performance.

name: Whitetail
description: Going back to the basics with our Norma Whitetail line. When hunting season starts, you want to be able to count on your ammunition. Norma's Whitetail line of ammunition is loaded with the highest quality brass that meets and exceeds the standard set forth by reloaders. Norma's proven soft-point bullet, matched with our premium brass case allows for confidence in shot to shot performance. Norma Whitetail is designed to deliver the shot to shot performance you need to ensure your next hunt is always successful.

name: A3 Mid-Size Binoculars
description: The Bushnell A3 offers the best of both worlds — compact enough to travel easily, yet powerful enough to capture every detail. Fully multi-coated lenses provide bright, crisp images, while the organic wave-texture armor gives a confident grip and modern look inspired by nature. With Waterproof (IPX7 rated) protection, EXO Barrier lens coatings, and the Snap-Lock strap system, A3 is ready for anything from road trips to ridge lines — backed by the Bushnell Lifetime Warranty.

name: Precision Hunter
description: Accuracy and terminal performance are the cornerstones of Hornady Precision Hunter factory loaded ammunition. Great care has been given by Hornady engineers to develop superior, match­-accurate hunting loads that allow the ELD­-X bullet to achieve its maximum ballistic potential.

name: V-Match
description: Innovation, precision and excitement! Elevate your shooting experience, shatter records, and make your mark like never before with Hornady V-Match ammunition. Whether you’re taking aim in competition or outwitting varmints, make V-Match your ammunition of choice. It combines exceptional aerodynamics with high-quality components for match-grade accuracy and violent expansion.

name: E Series Red Laser
description: Viridian's E SERIES laser sight is specifically designed for the everyday conceal and carry owner. This model specific, trigger guard mounted, laser sight offers the most powerful red laser legally available, delivering rapid target acquisition when you need it most.

name: Fullfield IV
description: The Burris Fullfield IV offers a wide field of view in a rugged, lightweight design.

name: Power-Shok Rifle
description: The traditional lead-core hunting bullets in Federal Power-Shok rifle loads provide solid accuracy and power at an affordable price. They feature reliable Federal brass, primers and powder and are suited to a wide variety of medium and big games.

name: Blazer Brass
description: Blazer Brass brings shooters the reliability and quality of ammunition built to SAAMI standards, and is backed by stringent ISO certified quality systems. Blazer Brass is loaded in reloadable brass cases for added value. Standard Boxer-type primers and primer pockets mean you can reload Blazer Brass cases just like any other case. Blazer Brass is loaded with a protected-base FMJ bullet. CCI primers insure reliable ignition, and we load clean-burning propellants.

name: DOGTAG Optic Plate
description: Optic Plates made by Calculated Kinetics are a great upgrade from the factory provided plates. Tighter tolerances, better screws, and a built-in deflection table to reduce carbon by 75% why would you get any other optic plate?

name: Double X
description: Winchester Double X ammunition has been used by hunters for decades. The copper-plated shot is protected by Grex buffering and it hits hard, consistently dropping turkeys every season. Whether velocity or payload is a preference, Winchester offers both High Velocity and Magnum loads in the Double X line.

name: Premium ELD-X
description: This match-accurate, hard-hitting hunting bullet stands apart thanks to an extremely high ballistic coefficient and a design that provides dynamic expansion at a wide range of velocities.

name: USA Handgun
description: Invest in deep penetration with Winchester USA Centerfire Handgun Ammunition. Now you can hit your targets harder with less noise. This harder hit will show you the difference between making a target wobble and making it fall down.

name: BinoX 4K
description: The ATN BinoX 4K 4-16x combined with our cutting edge Dual Core Processor, gives you unsurpassed image quality with richer and more vivid color tones. With the built-in laser rangefinder/IR illuminator. Not only do you have the ability to see both day and night at your fingertips, but you now have the ability to range your target with absolute accuracy. BIX (Ballistic Information Exchange) tech allows systems to talk to each other, exchanging valuable information; in order to facilitate a shooting solution eliminating hold over. Features video recording in 4K, dual stream video, ultra low power consumption and interpupillary adjustment.

name: Whitetail
description: Going back to the basics with our Norma Whitetail line. When hunting season starts, you want to be able to count on your ammunition. Norma's Whitetail line of ammunition is loaded with the highest quality brass that meets and exceeds the standard set forth by reloaders. Norma's proven soft-point bullet, matched with our premium brass case allows for confidence in shot to shot performance. Norma Whitetail is designed to deliver the shot to shot performance you need to ensure your next hunt is always successful.

name: Centerfire Handgun
description: PPU handgun ammunition is available in many popular calibers for pistols and revolver style handguns. Our handgun ammunition is brasscased, non-corrosive boxer primed and features our improved bullet designs which result in greater energy performance, bullet expansion and reliability.

name: Match
description: We carefully select every component to ensure uniformity, then load to exacting specifications to provide pinpoint accuracy. Each cartridge is loaded with either Hornady A-MAX bullets, our high-performance boat tail hollow points, or the new, radically superior ELD Match bullets. Stringent quality control ensures proper bullet seating, consistent charges and pressures, optimal velocity, consistent overall length and repeatable accuracy.

name: Vapor Scope Level
description: The Vapor Lightweight Scope Level represents an affordable, American-made quality accessory for your rifle. It's designed to attach directly onto your scope tube, ensuring the reticle remains consistently level—a critical factor as target distances increase. This scope level is specifically crafted to allow shooters to maintain reticle alignment without adjusting their stance or the rifle's position, providing ambidextrous configurations suitable for right or left-hand use. Installation is recommended in front of the turret assembly on the weak-eye side, creating an illusion of the bubble floating near your reticle when viewing with both eyes open.

name: Heritage Handgun
description: It is a marriage between new manufacturing technology combined with the history and heritage of hard-to-find calibers. Fiocchi Heritage ammunition is built from Old World craftsmanship with the understanding that historical curiosities and proven age-old designs still have a place in the modern era. Fiocchi produces ammunition at consistently high standards to ensure optimum performance while at the same time preserving the integrity of your sporting treasures.

name: DP Red Dot
description: This light weight Polymer heads-up (22mm X 33mm) display Reflex Optic with Red Dot reticle allows the shooter a wide field of view to quickly acquire and aim and engage their target. Integrated metal weaver type base mount will mount onto virtually any firearm.

name: Signature Universal Scope Ring
description: Signature rings are available for all types of optics and bases. Pos-Align inserts offer tremendous gripping power and durability and will not damage the scope finish. The benefits of this revolutionary design include consistent accuracy, tremendous gripping power and scratch free and stress free mounting. By putting a synthetic pivoting insert within a steel outer ring, your scope-to-ring surface area contact becomes virtually 100%.

name: ACOG 3.5x35 LED
description: With the Trijicon ACOG 3.5x35 LED riflescope, users can select from six adjustable brightness levels with an “off” between each setting, allowing the user to determine how much to illuminate the reticle - even in transitional lighting. Powered by a single AA battery, the LED ACOG can run for over 12,000 continuous hours (on setting #4). Like all ACOG models, the 3.5x35 LED is designed with a forged 7075-T6 aircraft-grade aluminum alloy housing, making it nearly indestructible.

name: Blazer Aluminum
description: Blazer Aluminum uses a non reloadable case made from high strength, aircraft gauge aluminum alloy. Clean burning propellants deliver optimum velocity while ensuring consistent chamber pressures. Cases are coated for smooth functioning and corrosion resistance. Non corrosive primers for highly sensitive and reliable performance. 50 rounds per box expect where noted.

name: Vapor 1 Piece Base
description: Warne Vapor rails are designed to offer shooters an affordable and reliable mounting platform manufactured for your specific firearm. Fits Picatinny & weaver style rings and are NATO-STANAG compatible. Made in USA.

name: American Whitetail
description: Opening day of deer season comes only once a year. Make sure you're ready when the big one steps out and load-up with Hornady American Whitetail ammunition.

name: Precision Hunter
description: Accuracy and terminal performance are the cornerstones of Hornady Precision Hunter factory loaded ammunition. Great care has been given by Hornady engineers to develop superior, match­-accurate hunting loads that allow the ELD­-X bullet to achieve its maximum ballistic potential.

name: Centerfire Handgun
description: PPU handgun ammunition is available in many popular calibers for pistols and revolver style handguns. Our handgun ammunition is brasscased, non-corrosive boxer primed and features our improved bullet designs which result in greater energy performance, bullet expansion and reliability.

name: DBAL-A3
description: The DBAL-A3 civilian model is based on the standard issue DBAL-A3 for U.S. warfighters. This unit offers the latest advances in IR and visible laser technology. The dual-beam infrared laser and illuminator combination is extremely accurate in low and no light maneuvers. Also, features defocused adjustable IR illumination technology to enable both midrange and close quarter target acquisition, low-profile windage and elevation adjusters, dual remote cable ports remote fire and visible override, single laser activation switch tap and release for momentary activation, tap twice for 5 minute continuous on and activation/low battery indicator light. Attach to any Picatinny rail using patented, self-adjusting Quick Release HT Mount.

name: Fusion Rifle
description: Fusion was the first rifle ammunition specifically built for deer hunting and it's still the best, offering the largest expansion and highest weight retention in head-to-head comparisons against the competition.

name: ProTarget Red Dot
description: Simmons has established itself as a visionary leader in high-quality, high-value riflescopes and binoculars. Since 1983, hunters and sportsmen alike have looked to Simmons for extraordinary optical innovation and rugged durability.

name: 5 Conquer
description: As Riton's ultimate hunting scope, the X5 Conquer provides maximum visibility in extreme has the perfect combination of clarity and durability to ensure every shot is a success. Featuring Riton HD glass, capped, Riton R5 Zero Stop turrets, an integrated throw lever, fast focus eyepiece, first focal plane and assembled in EP-level clean room. Includes flip-up lens covers, lens cloth and Allen wrench.

name: Field & Target
description: Many manufacturers use cheaper, softer shot or lesser grade powder and components to save money. In today's world, there are just too few opportunities to make that "shot of the day" to accept anything but the highest quality hunting shotshells available. NobleSport Italia Field & Target shotshells are assembled on the same machines, by the same craftsmen, to the same standards and using the same 21st century technology as NobleSport Italia 's world class target shotshells. Only the finest plastic cases, high antimony hard shot, even patterning wads and famous NobleSport Italia 209 primers are used in NobleSport Italia Field & Target shotshells.

name: Standard Rifle
description: Extensive line of rifle ammunition designed especially for big game hunting. Only the best quality components are used during production to ensure that our cartridges are accurate dependable and effective. Our constant quality improvements are based on the continual feedback from our customers, accurate, depend able and effective.

name: VOR-TX Long Range Rifle
description: VOR-TX LR is an extreme-distance load combining super-premium components that are assembled with a level of precision never before attained in factory ammunition. The specially engineered LRX bullets loaded in VOR-TX LR are optimized specifically for the cartridge. Unmatched flight characteristics combined with a specially engineered nose cavity that peels back into four cutting petals delivers massive expansion and identical on-game devastation from up close to well past 700 yards.

name: Shotshell
description: These standard velocity shot loads were engineered to happily knock birds out of the sky. They offer high quality, dependability, and affordable price.

name: Signature Rifle
description: The perfect ammo for hunting out in nature or at the range. You will not find a higher quality, better performing line of rifle ammo than the Signature Ammo, Inc. rifle line. Balancing velocity, accuracy, and recoil, our development team carefully analyses every load to help our ballisticians achieve the specific outcome of superiority.

name: 1 Tactix ARD
description: The 1 Tactix ARD is one of Riton’s most versatile red dots, whether you’re mounting it to an AR, AK, a shotgun, or a pistol. Featuring the Riton 2 MOA ultra-precise red dot, it comes with a lower 1/3 co-witness QD mount and a flush mount for the perfect mounting height no matter the platform.

name: RMRcc Mounting Plate
description: The Trijicon RMRcc mounting plate is designed to fit a verity of modern handguns.

name: Gold Dot Personal Protection
description: Gold Dot has earned the respect of police officers world-wide. No other ammunition combines such a consistent level of high performance. These loads deliver in all situations, which is why you can trust them for home and personal defense. Gold Dot hollow-point bullets are very accurate, tough and unbelievably consistent. 20 rounds per box.

name: Hunting Load
description: American Tactical Hunting Load for Shotgun Hunting

name: USA Rifle
description: Winchester USA brand ammunition provides great performance at a value price.

name: Contessa Scope Ring Set
description: The Riton by Contessa Light Picatinny Rings are precision machined from 7075 aluminum alloy. This set of fixed rings mounts directly to a picatinny rail with integral double recoil stops.

name: Premium Barnes LRX
description: The LRX bullet is specifically engineered razor-sharp petals produce massive wound channels even in dense, thick-skinned game. With deeper penetration, near double diameter expansion and higher weight retention than virtually any other projectile on the market today.

name: Drylok Super Steel
description: Magnum shotcup, Drylok Super Steel Wad, Water resistant, Plated Steel Shot, and Lacquered primer

name: R7 Scope
description: The R7 scope delivers the versatility hunters need when one scope has to do it all. ED Prime Glass enhances brightness and resolution during the critical first and last minutes of legal shooting light, while EXO Barrier helps maintain a clear view through changing weather conditions.

name: Cantilever Mount
description: Trijicon's Cantilever Mount w/ Trijicon Q-LOC Technology features a Mil-Spec drop test rated 6061-T6 aluminum design, with an easy to use one handed toolless mounting system. The spring-loaded design allows for constant retention and maintaining of zero even if the knobs are not tightened.

name: Centerfire Handgun
description: PPU handgun ammunition is available in many popular calibers for pistols and revolver style handguns. Our handgun ammunition is brasscased, non-corrosive boxer primed and features our improved bullet designs which result in greater energy performance, bullet expansion and reliability.

name: American Rifle Short Action Base
description: Made in the USA, this One-piece Picatinny scope base is designed for use with short action Ruger American Rifles. The MIL-STD Picatinny slot-and-rail spacing accepts Picatinny or Weaver scope rings. One-piece design is precision-machined from billet aluminum. The base is 6" long with a hardcoat anodized finish and includes (4) TORX mounting screws and a T-10 wrench.

name: E Series Green Laser
description: Viridian's E-Series line is specifically designed for everyday concealed carry and is available for the top brands and handguns on the market. The E-Series Green Laser Sights will easily mount to the trigger guard and feature an ambidextrous on/off button with a 5-minute auto shut off just like their Red Sight counterparts.

name: Super Pheasant
description: Winchester Super Pheasant is built for performance with long-range power, hard-hitting plated lead shot and a tight-patterning wad. Super Pheasant is an excellent choice for upland hunters on early to late season roosters.

name: 5K/6K Scope Ring Set
description: Ruger 1" aluminum scope rings. Sold as a set.

name: Terminal Ascent
description: Any hunt. Any range. Go beyond what you ever thought possible with Federal Premium Terminal Ascent. Bonded construction penetrates deep on close targets, while the patented Slipstream polymer tip initiates expansion at velocities 200 fps lower than comparable designs. The bullet's long, sleek profile offers an extremely high ballistic coefficient, and its AccuChannel groove technology improves accuracy and minimizes drag.

name: Nitro Steel
description: The steel serious waterfowlers depend on has been driven to new heights of performance. Remington NITRO-STEEL. Now with additional hard-hitting, higher velocity offerings. Premier, zinc-plated, 100% round pellets fly straight, delivering true close to long-range pattern performance.

name: Gold Dot Personal Protection
description: Gold Dot has earned the respect of police officers world-wide. No other ammunition combines such a consistent level of high performance. These loads deliver in all situations, which is why you can trust them for home and personal defense. Gold Dot hollow-point bullets are very accurate, tough and unbelievably consistent. 20 rounds per box.

name: Precision Match Rifle
description: Precision Match, engineered for precision at extreme distances, features exceptionally low standard deviations and extreme variations due to Barnes' exacting manufacturing and quality standards. Precision Match rounds are loaded with a match grade OTM (Open Tip Match) BT projectile featuring a long boat tail and high B.C. As an additional bonus, scan the QR code located on the back of each box to view Doppler radar generated drop tables specific to each load.

name: Super-X Pistol
description: For decades, hunters and shooters have relied on Winchester Super-X handgun ammunition. Best known for time-proven dependability, the rounds offered include a hollow point and lead core for rapid expansion on game, as well as a thin-wall jacket, which reduces engraving forces for improved accuracy.

name: 5 Primal
description: As Riton's ultimate hunting scope, the X5 Primal 3-1844 provides maximum visibility in extreme light conditions. Featuring Riton HD glass, capped, zero resettable turrets, an integrated throw lever, fast focus eyepiece and assembled in EP-level clean room. Includes flip-up lens covers, lens cloth and Allen wrench.

name: Liberator II
description: The second-generation Liberator red dot has improved features, including Shake N Wake auto on/off, a 2 MOA dot emitter, and a longer battery life. It offers 2 night vision and 8 daylight illumination settings and comes with both a low profile and an absolute co-witness height 1913 MIL-STD picatinny mount. It is small, durable, waterproof, and suitable for 12 gauge shotguns and .308 rifles. The lenses are fully multi-coated with anti-fog, anti-scratch, and hydrophobic coatings.

name: Long Beard XR
description: SHOT-LOK TECHNOLOGY. Protects Shot During In-Bore Acceleration. Shot launches from barrel near perfectly round for extremely tight long-range patterns. Twice the number of pellets in a 10" circle out to 60 yards. 10% greater penetration over standard lead loads beyond 50 yards. Devastating terminal on-target performances.

name: MBUS 3 Sight
description: The Magpul MBUS 3 front sight combines the best of both worlds from Magpul's line of back up sights. The low profile and minimalist design from the MBUS Pro combined with the lightweight impact resistant polymer of the original MBUS sights give you a cost effective and feature packed solution for mounting flip up sights on your rifle. When folded, the MBUS 3 sight is only .44 high and only 1.15 wide, so it sits on slimmer rails without overhanging. Additionally, the Magpul MBUS 3 front sight features the same spring-loaded technology that can be deployed by the press of an ambidextrous button.

name: Pioneer Handgun
description: Bring your lever gun out of retirement—it’s time to experience the superior on-game performance of Barnes Pioneer ammunition. Designed specifically for lever guns and revolvers, this ammo is carefully loaded for terminal performance and delivers massive expansion and weight retention for deeper penetration. Each round is engineered for flawless feeding and cycling from tubular magazine to chamber for lightning-fast follow-up shots.

name: Select Plus
description: Ultra-high velocity, magnum ammunition is how Roy Weatherby got started in the 1940s. As a young wildcatter, he revolutionized the industry with his fast, hard-hitting loads that were dead-on accurate. Today, those same performance qualities are every bit a part of Weatherby cartridges. Weatherby's move to Wyoming is an exciting step towards the continual opportunity for innovation. The cartridges that paved the way for advancement in ballistics and load development will forever be a solid foundation. Weatherby's intention is a constant progression for ballistic superiority, confidence in developing new and impressive cartridges that perform and meet expectations attached to the Weatherby brand.

name: Omnia Scope
description: Omnia precision riflescope is designed with features and performance tailored to the modern rifleman. Its magnification paired with an All Purpose Tactical Reticle (A.P.T.R.) illuminated MOA based reticle offers the best of both worlds for near-field CQB shooting and long distance precision fulfilling the entire range of tactical carbines. The scope also utilizes multi-coated lenses, locking and 1/4 MOA target turrets and a 30mm tube with fog-proof, water and shock resistant construction.

name: Gold Dot Short Barrel
description: Speer Short Barrel ammunition is designed to work in barrels as short as 2 inches and both law enforcement and private citizens have found the loads very impressive. They produce less felt recoil while achieving reliable expansion and performance at a variety of distances and velocities. 20 rounds per box.

name: Vapor 1 Piece Base
description: Warne Vapor rails are designed to offer shooters an affordable and reliable mounting platform manufactured for your specific firearm. Fits Picatinny & weaver style rings and are NATO-STANAG compatible. Made in USA.

name: VP9 Optics Plate
description: High quality components and precise manufacturing make H&K parts ideal for maintaining and upgrading firearms. The durability, reliability and excellent build quality of these parts will ensure years of service you can count on.

name: Centerfire Rifle
description: An excellent choice for value-conscious shooters wanting rifle rounds for target practice, hunting, or self defense.

name: Precision Rimfire 30 MOA Base
description: Ruger's Precision Rimfire 30 MOA scope base is intended for longer distance shooting with the Ruger Precision Rimfire. The rail is engineered specifically to fit the factory scope mount holes on the gun's receiver. MIL-STD Picatinny slot-and-rail spacing accepts Picatinny or Weaver scope rings. One-piece design is precision-machined from billet aluminum. Base is 5.25" long with a hardcoat anodized finish and includes (4) TORX mounting screws and a T-10 wrench. Made in the USA.

name: Pistol Red Dot Adapter
description: This mount is compatible with Trijicon RMR reflex sights. The mount is designed to be attached to Glock firearms. Adapts RMR-cut slides to fit other optic models.

name: Core-Lokt
description: Since 1939, more hunters have relied on Remington Core-Lokt than any other big game ammunition, and rightly so. It's filled more tags on more continents than any other load. Core-Lokt is the original controlled expansion bullet. Its time-proven performance has made it hunting's first choice for over 75 years. The tapered copper jacket is locked to a solid lead core delivering massive 2X expansion, weight retention and consistent on-game results. Available in soft point and pointed soft point versions, and in a range of bullet weights for virtually every centerfire hunting caliber made.

name: Subsonic Pistol
description: Subsonic Handgun utilizes tried-and-true XTP bullets that expand reliably at subsonic velocities. The Sub-X bullet used in Subsonic Rifle features a lead core. Long grooves in its gilding metal jacket combine with the bullet's flat profile and the patented Flex Tip insert within its hollowpoint cavity to help it expand reliably at low velocities.

name: Mini-Mag
description: The Mini-Mag was our original offering, and it’s still one of our most popular. The accurate 22 LR load minimizes fouling thanks to clean-burning powder and it feeds reliably with CCI priming and brass.

name: Scope Rings
description: In the early 1990’s Badger Ordnance identified the need for quality tactical scope rings and mounts designed to meet the higher demands of the emerging Military and Law Enforcement tactical shooting community. Badger Ordnance scope rings are machined from steel or aluminum bar stock as serialized matched pairs. This assures that both rings are identical and eliminates the damaging effects of mismatched, mass-produced rings.

name: Blazer Aluminum
description: Blazer Aluminum uses a non reloadable case made from high strength, aircraft gauge aluminum alloy. Clean burning propellants deliver optimum velocity while ensuring consistent chamber pressures. Cases are coated for smooth functioning and corrosion resistance. Non corrosive primers for highly sensitive and reliable performance. 50 rounds per box expect where noted.

name: ROF Mount
description: Made in the USA, the Reptilia ROF red dot mount is a drop-in upgrade for magnified scope mounts. It is compatible with Geissele Automatics' Super Precision 30mm optic mount, and adds a mounting point for a red dot to provide a fast, close-range optic to your magnified scope.

name: Veracity
description: The Burris Veracity's small enough for driven hunts and stalking in timber, but 10x magnification offers enough zoom for most longer range hunts as well. The compactness and low weight make it very popular for lightweight rigs. The 2-10x uses the Burris M.A.D. Knob System, which allows for custom etched knobs or quickly switching to available exposed knobs. It ships with low capped knobs. This model ships with both the covered and exposed elevation caps. The scope features Ballistic Plex E1 FFP, 5-times zoom system, 30mm tube and front focal plane reticle design allows the reticle size to increase or decrease as magnification is increased or decreased; trajectory compensation is always correct and proportional for the selected power setting.

name: Thor 5
description: The ATN THOR 5 LRF (Long Range Fusion) is a cutting-edge thermal riflescope specifically designed for long-range shooting and observation. It combines advanced thermal imaging technology with laser rangefinding capabilities, providing shooters with exceptional performance and accuracy in various conditions. The THOR 5 LRF utilizes a high-resolution thermal sensor that detects the heat signatures emitted by objects, ensuring clear and detailed imaging even in complete darkness or adverse weather conditions such as fog or smoke. With its thermal imaging capability, this riflescope allows users to see through obstacles and identify targets that are otherwise hidden to the naked eye.

name: Tenmile
description: The Trijicon Tenmile is a first focal plane riflescope that lets you dial-in long-range shots in any environment or light with confidence. Expect pinpoint precision at multiple ranges, all-weather performance and outstanding quality and design for repeatable precision. The MRAD Precision Tree reticle offers precise wind and range holds and the exposed zero stop elevation adjuster allows you to quickly return to zero. Includes Sunshade, Tenebraex Flip Caps, Scopecoat, 3mm and 1.5mm Hex key, repositionable magnification knob and replacement screw, CR2032 battery, quick reference guide, and logo sticker.

name: Thor 5
description: The ATN THOR 5 LRF (Long Range Fusion) is a cutting-edge thermal riflescope specifically designed for long-range shooting and observation. name: ACOG Mount
description: Aluminum ACOG mounts with American Defense Mfg's patented QD Auto Lock System.

name: X-Sight LTV
description: An affordable night vision scope, the X-Sight LTV scope is the latest addition to ATN’s lineup of HD optic night scopes. The X-Sight LTV features the great performance ATN customers have come to expect at an affordable price. The Day & Night mode offers vivid daytime clarity and superior nighttime performance through the QHD+ sensor. The rifle scope is optimized for up to 10 hours of battery life, while one-shot zeroing enables users to find targets with ease. The X-Sight LTV night vision scope is perfect for anyone looking for a high-performance device and hunting optics.

name: Silvertip Pistol
description: Trusted for decades when it matters most, Silvertip offers the time-proven design with the Power to Defend. Hollow Point, provides maximum stopping power for personal defense scenarios. Engineered Jacket Profile, ensures reliable functioning, precise accuracy and consistent expansion.

name: Rimfire
description: Aguila rimfire ammunition is manufactured to ensure optimal reliability, accuracy, and performance. The ammo features Aguila prime technology, which is engineered and tested to Olympic Shooting Standards.
