name: Credo
description: What we’ve learned from decades of deployment with America’s greatest fighting forces, we’ve put back into our technology for the Trijicon Credo tactical riflescope. It delivers an incredibly clear sight picture, green and red illuminated reticles, superior target acquisition, and rugged durability.

name: Match
description: We carefully select every component to ensure uniformity, then load to exacting specifications to provide pinpoint accuracy. Each cartridge is loaded with either Hornady A-MAX bullets, our high-performance boat tail hollow points, or the new, radically superior ELD Match bullets. Stringent quality control ensures proper bullet seating, consistent charges and pressures, optimal velocity, consistent overall length and repeatable accuracy.

name: Fire Sight Set
description: This fire sight set comes with front and rear, fiber optic sights, for the Ruger 10/22.

name: Condition One ARC Riser
description: The Condition One ARC Spacer Block allows the end user to raise any C1 ARC compatible accessory .250". This will allow extra clearance for taller elevation turrets found on some optics. Made from 6061 T-6 aluminum Type III Hardcoat Anodized.

name: Drylok Super Steel
description: Magnum shotcup, Drylok Super Steel Wad, Water resistant, Plated Steel Shot, and Lacquered primer

name: Ruggedized Rear ScopeCap
description: The Rear Ruggedized ScopeCap is a simple, rugged, and low-profile solution to protect your scope's rear lens. Their signature flipper tab is integral to the ScopeCap and allows for fast, easy removal from your scope's bezel. When doffed, the ScopeCap has a lower profile than traditional flip-style scope caps.

name: Deep Penetrating X Handgun
description: COR BON's DPX Handgun ammunition exhibits superior performance to all other defensive ammunition on the market. The reason is the homogenous solid copper projectile. Barrier blind is the new terminology for ammunition that outstandingly performs after penetrating a heavy barrier like auto glass or steel. DPX(R) is the only ammunition that maintains 100% of its weight after going through such barriers. The DPX bullet is a 100% solid copper bullet. Internal serration cuts have been added instead of traditional external serrations. These internal serration cuts allow the copper bullet to fully expand making the bullet double diameter with 6 razor sharp pedals.

name: Drylok Super Steel
description: Magnum shotcup, Drylok Super Steel Wad, Water resistant, Plated Steel Shot, and Lacquered primer

name: MRO SD
description: The Trijicon MRO (Miniature Rifle Optic) SD is a sealed, miniature reflex sight intended for use on rifles, carbines, and shotguns to provide fast target acquisition. The large aperture and tapered light path maximize the viewing area and allow for better situational awareness and fast target engagement. Combine all this with the ambidextrous brightness controls, sub-flush adjusters, advanced lens coatings and the fully sealed, waterproof, hard anodized forged 7075-T6 housing, and you have the ultimate mini reflex sight on the market. The MRO SD features a re-engineered objective lens allowing for enhanced optical performance and magnifier compatibility. The MRO SD is also equipped with improved windage and elevation adjusters designed to maintain stricter zero retention requirements under drop and recoil.

name: Master Class
description: Your competition has met its match. Federal Master Class competition-level sporting clay load features a customized Podium wad that extracts peak performance from Federal’s straight-wall hull. High-antimony lead shot, a reliable primer, and select propellant combine to break the most challenging targets in high-level sporting clays and FITASC shoots.

name: Top Mount Base
description: Each Weaver base is machined to tight tolerances for a custom fit. These Aluminum bases offer maximum strength for rings to hold tight.

name: Dovetail Rings
description: NcSTAR's mission is to provide superior quality, scopes, rings, mounts, and firearm accessories to the shooting community at an affordable price. With over 12 years of experience they are dedicated to providing innovative and cutting edge optics and accessories with higher end features. By following the latest industry trends and setting the highest standards in the industry, NcSTAR has become the preferred choice of many professional, armed forces, and civilian consumers.

name: Match
description: We carefully select every component to ensure uniformity, then load to exacting specifications to provide pinpoint accuracy. Each cartridge is loaded with either Hornady A-MAX bullets, our high-performance boat tail hollow points, or the new, radically superior ELD Match bullets. Stringent quality control ensures proper bullet seating, consistent charges and pressures, optimal velocity, consistent overall length and repeatable accuracy.

name: Signature HD Scope
description: Shooters and hunters who routinely shoot at shorter distances will benefit from the Burris Signature HD 2-10x40 rifle scope's wide viewing angle and low magnification. Featuring the Ballistic E3 reticle, shooters are given a simple method for determining holdover and wind drift. The 2-10x40 is built with a one-inch nitrogen-filled tube and includes push/pull locking turrets that can easily be reset to "0".

name: Contessa Scope Ring Set
description: The Riton by Contessa Light Picatinny Rings are precision machined from 7075 aluminum alloy. This set of fixed rings mounts directly to a picatinny rail with integral double recoil stops.

name: Gun Club Target
description: Remington Gun Club Target Loads deliver the shot-to-shot consistency you expect in a target load. Perfect for high-volume, economical shooting, these shells are loaded with high-quality components allowing reloaders to use the hulls over and over. Featuring Gun Club Grade Shot, Premier STS Primers, and Power Piston One-Piece Wads, these high-quality shells receive the same care in loading as the top-of-the-line Premier STS and Nitro 27 shells. This reloadable shell is designed to stretch your shooting dollar.

name: RMU Mount
description: The RMU Mount by Reptilia is a lightweight, slim-line solution manufactured at the request of a DoD customer. The RMU Mounts are idea for lifting a variety of optics with fixed height, lower 1/3 co-witness heights such as the EOTech line of holographic optics, Vortex Optics AMG UH-1, and Sig Optics ROMEO8T to an elevated height which is more ergonomic when using helmet-borne night vision or those who prefer a more upright shooting stance. The RMU Mount is machined from billet 7075-T6 aluminum with Milspec Type III hard anodized finish, the RMU Mount attaches to any M1913 Picatinny rail, and offers optimal sight placement with an increase in height of .625 inches. Its spring-loaded nitrided steel clamp and mounting bolt simplify the installation process, and sit flush with the body of the mount for a low-profile, anti-snag design.

name: Super-X Xpert
description: Consistent, Dependable Performance. Exceptional Quality and Outstanding Performance. Time Proven Dependability. Long-range knock-down. One-Piece Hinged Wad: For consistent, tight patterns and reduced felt-recoil. Famous 209 Primer and Clean Burning Powder Reliable ignition and consistent velocity.

name: Texas Dove
description: Deliver patterns and power as big as Texas to drop even the most erratic birds. Federal Texas Dove shotshell loads are consistent and reliable, with high velocities that make the most of the payload.

name: Veracity
description: The Burris Veracity's small enough for driven hunts and stalking in timber, but 10x magnification offers enough zoom for most longer range hunts as well. The compactness and low weight make it very popular for lightweight rigs. The 2-10x uses the Burris M.A.D. Knob System, which allows for custom etched knobs or quickly switching to available exposed knobs. It ships with low capped knobs. This model ships with both the covered and exposed elevation caps. The scope features Ballistic Plex E1 FFP, 5-times zoom system, 30mm tube and front focal plane reticle design allows the reticle size to increase or decrease as magnification is increased or decreased; trajectory compensation is always correct and proportional for the selected power setting.

name: Helos BTR Gen2
description: Built with versatility in mind the Athlon Helos is a hunting scope designed with generations of hunting experience. The variable power gives the ability hunt game in the close Texas brush or on the wide open plains providing limitless versatility and with the first focal plane the holder over is the same at any magnification. Its multi-coated lenses offer better light transmission and clarity at dawn and dusk the time when most game is taken. Athlon scopes are constructed from a one piece tube for durability and dependability. Their fog proof, water proof and Argon purged design ensures that no matter the elements your scope stays crystal clear. For versatility and value the Athlon optics cannot be beat, offering everything the modern hunter needs in a rifle scope.

name: 3 Primal Binocular
description: The 3 Primal HD binoculars from Riton offer vision and clarity well beyond your expectations. The HD glass optical system is encased in a lightweight PVC-wrapped magnesium-aluminum alloy, so no matter where your hunt takes you, you know your optics are rugged enough to handle it. The HD glass and BAK4 prisms provide clear and bright images, and weighing just under 27 ounces, the 3 Primal HD binoculars won’t strain your eyes or your arms.

name: USA Handgun
description: Invest in deep penetration with Winchester USA Centerfire Handgun Ammunition. Now you can hit your targets harder with less noise. This harder hit will show you the difference between making a target wobble and making it fall down.

name: Super Suppressed Rifle
description: The use and ownership of suppressors across the United States continues to grow in popularity. Winchester introduces a new line of ammunition called Super Suppressed made specifically for shooting through firearms outfitted with a suppressor.

name: Lawman
description: Lawman encompasses all our brass-case, general purpose ammunition. Bullets are either Speer TMJ or conventional full metal jacket depending on the product. There are times you don't need a hollow point bullet, like when target shooting, training, or out for an afternoon of plinking. Lawman is right at home. Lawman is attractively priced, and the cases are reloadable. We load clean-burning propellants and reliable CCI primers to complete the package. Many Lawman loads duplicate the velocities and bullet weights we load in Gold Dot so your practice is realistic.

name: Super-X Slugs
description: The Super-X is made using precise manufacturing processes and the highest quality components to provide consistent, dependable performance that generations of shooters continue to rely upon. For superior slug performance, you can't beat the stopping power of Winchester Super-X Slugs. Designed to shoot better in smooth bore shotguns.

name: Picatinny Base Weatherby
description: Talley's Picatinny Base is constructed of 7075-T6 aluminum with a matte black finish. This model is compatible with Weatherby Accumark, Magnum and Mark V.

name: Maxima Base
description: The Maxima Steel Bases are modeled around the popular Weaver design. The low profile of the Maxima Steel Bases give your firearm a sleek look. When used in conjunction with Warne Maxima QD Rings, the shooter is able to utilize the open sights by looking over the top of the bases without sacrificing the normal shooting position behind the firearm. Maxima Bases offer a full width recoil slot in each base. This feature allows the recoil control keys of Warne Rings to attain maximum bearing surface.

name: E-Tech
description: Winchester E-Tech shotshells are loaded with revolutionary BioAmmo wads made from bio-polymers that look and perform like traditional plastic. Whether on the clay range, or in the field, the environmental technology in E-Tech shotshells is impactful on target.

name: Black Rifle
description: Hornady BLACK ammunition features versatile loads optimized for excellent performance from America's favorite guns. Loaded with legendary Hornady bullets, Hornady BLACK ammunition is designed to fit, feed and function in a variety of platforms. Direct impingement, gas piston, suppressed, unsuppressed, inertia, bolt, pump, supersonic, subsonic, rifle, mid-length, carbine or pistol Hornady BLACK ammunition delivers superior performance for a variety of applications. Made in the USA.

name: Gun Club Target
description: Remington Gun Club Target Loads deliver the shot-to-shot consistency you expect in a target load. Perfect for high-volume, economical shooting, these shells are loaded with high-quality components allowing reloaders to use the hulls over and over. Featuring Gun Club Grade Shot, Premier STS Primers, and Power Piston One-Piece Wads, these high-quality shells receive the same care in loading as the top-of-the-line Premier STS and Nitro 27 shells. This reloadable shell is designed to stretch your shooting dollar.

name: AccuPoint
description: When you want the very best without compromise, without fail, without second guessing, go with a Trijicon AccuPoint riflescope. Designed with battery-free illumination that's always on, the AccuPoint is as technologically sophisticated as it is tough.

name: Self Defense
description: Cor-Bon's Self Defense JHP ammunition is made to the highest standards. Made with it's own exclusively designed jacketed hollow point bullets ensures excellent penetration and expansion. Cor-Bon has performed extensive tests on their projectiles in a test medium of 10% ballistic gelatin. Cor-Bon believes that velocity is king, and they deliver.

name: ProTarget Rimfire
description: Simmons ProTarget Rimfire Riflescopes feature interchangeable ballistic elevation turrets for 1/4 MOA, .22LR, and .17hmr with fully multi-coated lenses and Weaver style rings included!

name: BTH35 V2
description: The Thermal Handheld will hot track targets out past 750 yards in the dead of night and features real time WIFI-to-mobile connectivity that allows a mobile device to simultaneously view, control, and record from the handheld using the Burris Thermal App. Add in 5 color palettes, stadiametric ranging, hot track, brightness and contrast controls, picture-in-picture, and an incredibly smooth 4X zoom feature and you have one of the most useful and full featured scanning and tracking tools on the market at any price!

name: Double X
description: Winchester Double X ammunition has been used by hunters for decades. The copper-plated shot is protected by Grex buffering and it hits hard, consistently dropping turkeys every season. Whether velocity or payload is a preference, Winchester offers both High Velocity and Magnum loads in the Double X line.

name: Ring/Base Combo Weatherby Mark V
description: Talley's Lightweight Scope Mount features a unique, one-piece construction extruded from 7000 series alloy and precision CNC-machined to its final design. It has no joint between the scope and the rifle which ultimately provides more strength and durability than most steel rings and bases, but with a lighter overall weight. This model is compatible with Weatherby Mark V rifles.

name: Superformance
description: Superformance uses progressive propellants that take your favorite V-MAX, NTX, SST, CX, and InterLock, bullets to levels of performance that are simply unattainable with conventional ammunition.

name: Picatinny Base Short Action Browning X-Bolt

name: Pow'rBall
description: The Pow'RBall is a gilding metal jacket filled with a lead core that's shaped into a Patented V shape, then capped with a round polymer ball which is crimped and held in place by the copper jacket. During flight, the polymer ball disperses air around the bullet making it more aerodynamic, which improves ballistics. The ball also enhances feeding in auto pistols. During impact the polymer ball delays expansion allowing it to penetrate several inches before it is pushed out of the way exposing the lead V shape cavity, causing the bullet to fully expand properly. Another benefit of the polymer ball is that it protects the integrity of the hollow point by not allowing clothing or other material to plug up the hollow point cavity causing it to fail to expand.

With the ever-expanding options available to shooters in the accessory and electro-optic markets, Badger Ordnance saw the need for a mount that can make the most use of precious real estate on rifle platforms while acting as a centralized hub for attachments and not suffering from deflection seen on optics and lasers attached to handguards. The C1 Modular Mount offers the end user four accessory mounting points on the Unimount body both left, right, fore, and aft to suit a wide range of shooter's needs. Unlike traditional ring cap accessories, the C1 accessories can be located in the same height and offset throughout various main mount heights giving the shooter a more consistent offset throughout models. Made from 7075-T6 aluminum Type III Hard Coat Anodized. Weight 5.0oz.

name: Super Precision Scope Mount
description: The AR-15/M4 Super Precision series of scope mounts are optimized for use with an AR-15/M4 upper. The mounting surface spans 7 picatinny sections and utilizes 4 shear lugs. These mounts use Geissele's update of the classic nut and bolt method for clamping the mount to the picatinny rail, which is the most secure method of attaching your scope to your weapon. Each nut and bolt combination provides 1,400 pounds of clamping force.

name: SLx MicroPrism
description: The Primary Arms SLx MicroPrism is an ultra compact 1X prism optic with a 17mm objective and an etched, illuminated ACSS reticle that remains usable without illumination. It is night vision compatible, built on the Aimpoint Micro footprint, and includes a 2.26 inch mount.

name: Centerfire Rifle

name: ACOG 3x30
description: Designed specifically for law enforcement and military applications, the Trijicon ACOG 3x30 (Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight) riflescope offers the right combination of ample magnification, low light capability and long eye relief for users who need fast target identification and maximum situational awareness. Equipped with Trijicon's Bindon Aiming Concept (BAC) feature, the ACOG 3x30 allows users to keep both eyes open while engaging targets.

name: 6K Scope Ring
description: Ruger scope ring designed to fit a scope with a 1" scope tube diameter and a 62mm objective diameter. Sold individually. Clam package.

name: Express XLR Shotshell
description: Simply, the best-balanced, tightest-patterning upland field loads available. Now in a bold new look, and the same premium performance decades of shooters have come to know and trust. The time-proven excellence of Express XLR Extra Long Range line now with five brand new loadings - 12 gauge to 410 bore - and shot sizes ranging from #2 all the way down to #7 1/2 for everything from pheasant and quail to rabbits and squirrels.

name: Red Dot Riser
description: The Warne red dot riser mount was designed to offer easy height adjustments between absolute and lower 1/3 co-witness in one package to fit red dot optics. All riser mounts that we offer share a robust mounting base, while the top is engineered specially for different red dot styles. Our risers Include a .180" thick spacer. Fits the T1-T2, H1-H2, Crossfire, Romeo 5 Red Dot and Holosun 403, 503, 515, 530.

name: V-Match
description: Innovation, precision and excitement! Elevate your shooting experience, shatter records, and make your mark like never before with Hornady V-Match ammunition. Whether you’re taking aim in competition or outwitting varmints, make V-Match your ammunition of choice. It combines exceptional aerodynamics with high-quality components for match-grade accuracy and violent expansion.

name: USA Rimfire
description: With a reputation steeped in tradition, Winchester has earned the moniker 'The American Legend' by delivering on their commitment to innovation & excellence in everything Winchester does.

name: RFX 45
description: The all-new RFX 45 is packed with industry-leading features while offering a tremendous value to the shooter. A rock-solid machined 6061 aluminum housing, fully multi coated lenses, audible and tactile adjustability, INSTANT-ON activation w/ memory and auto shut off and a 50k hour battery life are just a few of the features that make the RFX 45 a must-have for any shooter.

name: Range Line
description: The PPU Range Line Ammunition is expertly designed for shooters seeking reliable performance in both recreational and training environments. This Full Metal Jacket (FMJ) ammunition is crafted to deliver consistent accuracy and precision, making it a favored choice among enthusiasts who demand high standards from their firearm supplies. PPU is renowned for its attention to detail and use of quality materials, ensuring that each round of the Range Line series provides dependable results and enhances shooting experiences.

name: ACE Thermal Weapon Sight
description: The ACE is built around the idea of combining leading user-requested features in a streamlined optic that balances advanced capability with ease-of-use in the field. Designed to feel like a traditional day optic, the ACE is compatible with bolt action or semi-automatic rifles using standard 30 mm mounts and rings. The combination of an internal USB-C charging battery and a removable 18650 style rechargeable battery allows users to hot-swap batteries in the field to run indefinitely. A 1-3x ocular magnifier provides optical magnification of the 2560X2560 round AMOLED display inside the eyepiece. The Vision+ system pairs this high-resolution display with a 15 mK NETD sensor for an incredibly detailed and precise image.

name: Ballistic SilverTip
description: Winchester's Ballistic SilverTip is a polymer tipped bullet with alloyed lead core, contoured jacket, lubalox (black oxide) coating that produces rapid controlled expansion with massive knockdown and moderate penetration.

name: Super-X Rifle
description: Super-X rifle ammunition is made using precise manufacturing processes and the highest quality components to provide consistent, dependable performance that generations of shooters continue to rely upon.

name: Centerfire Handgun
description: An excellent choice for value-conscious shooters wanting handgun rounds for target practice or self defense. Boxer-primed brass cases for reloading.

name: Gold Dot LE Duty
description: Speer Ammunition, a key player in the industry for decades, brings innovation and reliability to its products. The Gold Dot LE Duty series was developed to meet the rigorous demands of law enforcement agencies worldwide. With a commitment to quality and performance, Speer has refined its hollow-point design to ensure consistent expansion and penetration in various conditions. The +P version of the Gold Dot ammunition offers increased pressure for enhanced velocity and energy, crucial for self-defense situations.

name: Super-X Cowboy
description: Winchester Super-X Cowboy Action Handgun Ammo is designed for cowboy action shooters who need high accuracy and consistent performance. Lubricated for a highly accurate, consistent bullet. For the serious centerfire handgun shooter; accurate, sure functioning, controlled recoil. For indoor and outdoor range, plinking, target, and match shooting.

name: Rangemaster
description: Recognized for dependability, PPU RANGEMASTER ammunition is manufactured using the highest grade materials and quality production control, ensuring precision performance in accordance with military specifications.

name: Custom
description: Shooters looking for supreme accuracy and maximum knock-down power turn to Hornady Custom ammunition. Loaded with a variety of Hornady bullets for rifle and pistol, the excellent terminal performance of Hornady Custom ammunition makes it the preferred choice for hunters, competitive shooters, and plinkers.

name: Fastfire 4
description: Instant dot-on-target accuracy for any firearm from handgun to shotgun. A great choice for 3-Gun and wing shooting, and any use from patrol to plinking. Multiple reticle options, massive battery life and 4 different models make FastFire 4 the most versatile red dot reflex you can mount.

name: Rimfire Field Dynamics
description: For hunting and high-volume shooting and plinking with your favorite rimfire handgun and rifle, Fiocchi offers several different loads for your 22 long rifle shooter. Known for consistent quality at an economical price, Fiocchi 22's allow you to shoot for lots of fun or hunting without having to deal with the problems of cheaper rimfire ammo such as duds, fail to function, excessive powder fouling, etc. Many shooters tell Fiocchi they are able to get match accuracy from their hunting rifles.

name: Bronze Pistol
description: The same quality and dependability built into our Starfire ammunition is incorporated throughout our extensive line of PMC training ammunition and standard hollow point or soft point ammunition. All PMC cartridges must pass through the rigorous inspection of our electronic powder check station. This station accurately measures the propellant charge in each round. If the propellant in any cartridge varies by a tiny amount - just two tenths of one grain - the system stops and that cartridge is discarded. 50 rounds per box except where noted.

name: Core-Lokt
description: Since 1939, more hunters have relied on Remington Core-Lokt than any other big game ammunition, and rightly so. It's filled more tags on more continents than any other load. Core-Lokt is the original controlled expansion bullet. Its time-proven performance has made it hunting's first choice for over 75 years. The tapered copper jacket is locked to a solid lead core delivering massive 2X expansion, weight retention and consistent on-game results. Available in soft point and pointed soft point versions, and in a range of bullet weights for virtually every centerfire hunting caliber made.

name: Match Rifle
description: Produced with the highest quality raw materials and components available. Extensive loadings are available for military, sporting and target shooting, all of which perfectly match the user's requirements to results.

name: Blazer Aluminum

Clean burning propellants deliver optimum velocity while ensuring consistent chamber pressures. Cases are coated for smooth functioning and corrosion resistance. Non corrosive primers for highly sensitive and reliable performance. 50 rounds per box expect where noted.

name: Contessa Scope Ring Set
description: The Riton by Contessa Light Picatinny Rings are precision machined from 7075 aluminum alloy. This set of fixed rings mounts directly to a picatinny rail with integral double recoil stops.

name: Champion Training
description: Federal Champion Training handgun loads provide accurate, target-grade performance. They're loaded with quality brass and primers and are affordably priced for volume shooters.

name: A3 Mid-Size Binoculars
description: The Bushnell A3 offers the best of both worlds — compact enough to travel easily, yet powerful enough to capture every detail. Fully multi-coated lenses provide bright, crisp images, while the organic wave-texture armor gives a confident grip and modern look inspired by nature. With Waterproof (IPX7 rated) protection, EXO Barrier lens coatings, and the Snap-Lock strap system, A3 is ready for anything from road trips to ridge lines — backed by the Bushnell Lifetime Warranty.

name: Field Dynamics
description: Shotguns provide a diversity of small- and medium-sized game hunting opportunities. That requires an equally diverse selection of shotshell loads. Fiocchi’s expansive line of Field Dynamics shotshells ensures you will find a load that is just right for every hunt. They are made to the same exacting standards and with the high-quality components typical of Fiocchi’s top-shelf ammunition.

name: Super Target
description: Get more performance at the range for less with Winchester Super Target shotshells. Designed to give you outstanding clay-busting performance at the range or in competitions without hitting your wallet as hard as many competitors.

name: High Terminal Performance
description: Now is no time for compromise. Combining premium primers, brass cases and propellants with a wide assortment of bullet designs, Remington HTP gives you the confidence and instant-stopping power you need for when it matters most. name: Bolt L35R
description: The BOLT L35R is a no-nonsense thermal weapon sight built for hunters who demand reliability and real-world performance. At its core is a 384x288 12m sensor paired with a crisp 35mm F1.0 lens, offering excellent image clarity and a detection range of up to 1,800 yards. The 1024x768 AMOLED display provides sharp, smooth visuals, even in the worst conditions. With built-in photo and video recording (with audio), WiFi connectivity, multiple zeroing profiles, and standard 18650 battery compatibility for up to 6.5 hours of total runtime, the L35R is packed with features designed for serious hunters. name: PVS-31a
description:
The L3Harris AN/PVS-31A is an extremely light weight binocular night vision goggle. The PVS-31A was designed by L3 in conjunction with USSOCOM to replace the PVS-15. The unit features an articulating housing with manual gain, a battery pack, and incredible tube resolution.

The PVS-31 can be run both off of an onboard AA battery or powered from the included battery pack. Because of the light weight design, the user does not need to run a counterweight and can simply use the battery pack to balance the helmet. The PVS-31 battery pack also has an on board IR strobe for signaling and aerial identification. The IR strobe is operated by a single switch on the back of the battery pack. One great thing about the ability to run a battery pack is the speed in which the goggles can be up and running. With the PVS-31 the user simply can drop the dovetail on a Wilcox G24 mount and plug in the battery cable to the battery pack port on the PVS-31 housing and use their goggles.

The AN/PVS-31A has an articulating housing with independently rotating optical pods. This lets the user deploy both tubes or a single tube. This is especially helpful when users are deploying their PVS-31’s while using a thermal device. The optical pod articulation also lets users stow their goggles without having to flip the goggles up on the helmet mount. This reduces snag hazard and additional height added to the helmet.

Tube Specs

The AN/PVS-31A uses L3Harris Unfilmed White Phosphor autogated image intensifier tubes with a 2376 min FOM rating from the factory. These unfilmed tubes provide incredible clarity, low light and high light performance, and increased depth perception. These are L3’s most advanced intensifier tubes and offers significant performance increases over other white phosphor systems.

2376 minimum FOM Unfilmed White Phosphor – Aviation Grade:

• FOM: 2376 minimum

• Aviation Spot Spec: Max 3 spots per tube larger than .003″ in zone 3, no spots larger than .003″ in zone 1 or 2. Spots </= .003″ are acceptable.

• This option is for our customers that want a stricter spot spec offered from the factory. This option is hand selected strictly to meet the above aviation spot spec.

ITAR Restricted. Leadtime approx. 2 weeks.

name: R5 Binoculars
description: R5 binoculars deliver enhanced optical performance, upgraded materials, and advanced features not found in its price point and class.

name: Grand Slam
description: Extend the range and enhance the lethality of conventional turkey payloads with all-new Federal Premium Grand Slam. Its FLITECONTROL FLEX wad system works in both standard and ported turkey chokes.

name: Core-Lokt Tipped
description: Big game meet bigger game. New for hunting season, this is Core-Lokt Tipped. Offering proven on-game performance with improved accuracy and long-range potential, it’s fair to say the legend just became more legendary. Thousands of rounds in development, Core-Lokt Tipped combines truer flight, flatter trajectory and devastating terminal energy. No wonder it’s the consistent choice of serious hunters all over the world.

name: Ballistic Tip Varmint Rifle
description: Ballistic Tip VARMINT Ammunition consists of the venerable Ballistic Tip VARMINT bullet or the frangible Ballistic Tip Lead Free along with Nosler brass. To further ensure our reputation for quality and consistency, powder charges are meticulously weighed and finished rounds are visually inspected and polished.

name: EFLX-CE
description: Built for the professional user, the EFLX CE delivers the trusted performance of EOTECH optics in a fully enclosed design that protects the LED from debris, moisture, and impact. The EFLX CE base adapts to either the Leupold Delta Point Pro or Shield RMS-c footprint. Top-mounted controls manage power, reticle brightness, and programmable sleep settings, while shake-awake technology instantly reactivates the sight with the slightest movement. The multi-reticle system lets users choose between a precise 3 MOA dot, a 42 MOA circle, or a combined circle-and-dot conguration. A side-load CR2032 battery delivers up to 25,000 hours of runtime, and large windage and elevation adjusters allow for quick, tool-assisted zeroing. For added condence, an integrated rear backup iron sight is machined directly into the housing.

name: MMX4 Magnifier
description: The Mepro MMX4 micro magnifier is compact, lightweight magnifier that will extend your effective range of your red dot or 1x reflex sight. Weighing in at 6.9 it reduce the footprint, saving rail space and weight on your firearm. Elevation and windage dials provide precise FOV line of sight alignment. A wide FOV enables rapid target acquisition with both eyes open which is ideal where agility, and speed are of the utmost importance. The Mepro MMX4 micro magnifier attach to any MIL-STD-1913 rail directly behind your optic. When not in use the Mepro MMX4 can be “flipped” out of the way by depressing a pushbutton.

name: Pistol Optic Plate
description: Night Fision's Pistol Optic Plates offer precision, durability, and value for shooters needing a mounting solution for their red dot sight. Crafted from premium 17-4 stainless steel and built to the tightest tolerances, these plates withstand harsh recoil and ensure a secure, accurate fit. The nitride coating provides extra protection, and each package includes extra screws and an installation tool for easy setup.

name: R5 Scope
description: The new Bushnell R5 scope series features advanced optical performance, illuminated reticles, and durable construction, making it ideal for hunters and shooters.

name: RMR Mount
description: Talley RMR Mounts are machined entirely from high grade 6000 series alloy and protected with a black anodized finish ensuring the craftsmanship of these Direct RMR Mounts last the lifetime of firearms. The Winchester Super X Series RMR Mounts are all designed and manufactured with precision to fit shotguns with the industry's tightest manufacturing tolerances. These RMR Direct mounts provide a mounting platform for RMR foot print Red Dot optics eliminating the need for a picatinny rail or other adapters for specified firearms.

name: Slugger Rifled Slug
description: Always in the forefront of deer slug technology, we redesigned our 12-gauge Slugger Rifled Slug for a 25% improvement in accuracy. Also, at 1760 fps muzzle velocity, our 3" 12-ga. Magnum slugs shoot 25% flatter than regular 12-ga. slugs.

When used in conjunction with Warne Maxima QD Rings, the shooter is able to utilize the open sights by looking over the top of the bases without sacrificing the normal shooting position behind the firearm. name: High Over All

name: Wilcox G24 Mount
description:
Wilcox G24 Mount

The Wilcox L4 G24 breakaway mount provides rock solid attachment for night vision goggles or j-arms with a dovetail interface. The Wilcox G24 mounts to any helmet using an Ops-Core VAS or standard Army shroud. The G24 mounting system allows the mount to break away from the shroud when stressed or sharp force is applied. This protect the user from possible neck injury if their night vision becomes trapped during activities such as repelling, hard impacts, or maritime applications. This breakaway feature is user configurable to be set to break away or stay attached depending on the users needs.

The Wilcox G24 mount provides a wide range of adjustment to allow for proper eye position. The mount provides both height adjustment and cant adjustment. This allows the user to both raise and lower their unit, as well as, adjust the angle of the night vision.

The Wilcox G24 mount is our favorite night vision helmet mount. This mount is great for both binocular night vision, as well as, monoculars. We believe this is the best helmet mount on the market. We recommend the G24 mount when customers are using a dovetail mounting system on their unit. This mount provides a long term option as users can switch from a monocular with a dovetail j-arm, to a bridge system, to a binocular setup without changing their mount.

*Please note – anodizing color can vary slightly by batch*

name: Pistol Dot
description: The Sun Optics RAID pistol dot is a compact sight that is ready for action. The wide lens and thin frame provide a wide-open and unobstructed sight picture while the bright 6MOA dot presents a crisp, precise aiming point. The design of the body is designed to help deflect minor bumps and bangs away from the lens protecting the glass and special coatings that offer a very clear, and night vision compatible, viewing plane.

name: Buckshot
description: Whether you use your shotgun for defense, hunting or competitive shooting, choose from the wide variety of Sellier & Bellot buckshot loads to give you the edge in any shooting scenario. Tight downrange patterns combined with excellent stopping power make Sellier & Bellot the perfect choice for your next hunting adventure.

name: Stinger
description: Want something that shoots flat and anchors varmints fast? Fill your mag with CCI Stinger 22 LR. The loads smoke out the muzzle at 1,640 fps and are loaded within industry standard pressures. They provide consistent, reliable performance thanks to CCI priming and brass.

name: Super-X Rimfire
description: Winchester Super-X Rimfire cartridges are the most technologically advanced ammunition. By combining advanced development techniques and innovative production processes, they have elevated ammunition performance to its highest level.

name: MOS Plates
description: The MOS system allows you to mount the sight you want quickly and easily using only a few tools. Changing the sight is just as easy; just remove the old sight, remove and reinstall the correct adapter plate, and mount the new sight.

name: Scope Rings
description: Made from aircraft aluminum alloy with heavy duty steel locking plate for maximum strength holding. Twist lock for quick and easy installation, strong recoil stop cross bolt for optimized fit.

name: 3 Series Conquer
description: The 3 Conquer 6-24x50 is the scope to help you reach great distance shooting without the normal cost of a distance scope. With Riton HD glass and a First Focal Plane (FFP), illuminated reticle, the 3 Conquer 6-24x50 features exposed, Riton R3 Zero Stop turrets, an integrated throw lever, and a 30mm tube to help break any distance barrier.

name: Weatherby Ring/Base Combo
description: Ring and base combo for Weatherby rifles

name: Xpert Steel
description: Waterfowl hunters live for the thrill of those adrenaline-packed moments when birds start dropping into the decoys. Decades of success on waterfowl has made XPERT High Velocity Steel shotshells truly legendary. The time-proven dependability of XPERT shotshells is offered in a wide range of gauges and payloads, and will be filling your limit for generations to come.

name: Core-Lokt
description: Since 1939, more hunters have relied on Remington Core-Lokt than any other big game ammunition, and rightly so. It's filled more tags on more continents than any other load. Core-Lokt is the original controlled expansion bullet. Its time-proven performance has made it hunting's first choice for over 75 years. The tapered copper jacket is locked to a solid lead core delivering massive 2X expansion, weight retention and consistent on-game results. Available in soft point and pointed soft point versions, and in a range of bullet weights for virtually every centerfire hunting caliber made.

name: American Whitetail
description: Opening day of deer season comes only once a year. Make sure you're ready when the big one steps out and load-up with Hornady American Whitetail ammunition.

name: Presidio LR2
description: Offering a wide magnification range for close to mid-range shooting, the Presidio 3-18x50 combines elite performance with a sleek, stealthy appearance. Designed for shooters, the Presidio 3-18x features a first focal plane reticle calibrated for a maximum caliber of .338, red reticle illumination for contrast against targets and low light shooting, and fully multi-coated optics. Its capped, low-profile turrets produce clear, audible clicks and feature aggressive exterior 'knurling', to add a distinct tactile feel to give shooters greater confidence when adjusting their windage and elevation. With built-in zero stops, and a single piece, 30mm tube and aircraft grade aluminum construction, the Presidio is extremely accurate and durable. IP67 waterproof and dust-proof, the Presidio is ideal for a variety of firearms, including ARs and bolt actions rifles.

name: Superformance Varmint
description: SuperformanceVarmint ammunition delivers muzzle velocity increases of 100 to 200 feet per second from EVERY gun. Accuracy, increased range, flatter trajectory, less wind drift and devastating terminal results are all realized with SuperformanceVarmint ammunition. 20 rounds per box.

name: Select Plus
description: Ultra-high velocity, magnum ammunition is how Roy Weatherby got started in the 1940s. As a young wildcatter, he revolutionized the industry with his fast, hard-hitting loads that were dead-on accurate. Today, those same performance qualities are every bit a part of Weatherby cartridges. Weatherby's move to Wyoming is an exciting step towards the continual opportunity for innovation. The cartridges that paved the way for advancement in ballistics and load development will forever be a solid foundation. Weatherby's intention is a constant progression for ballistic superiority, confidence in developing new and impressive cartridges that perform and meet expectations attached to the Weatherby brand.

name: Bronze Pistol
description: The same quality and dependability built into our Starfire ammunition is incorporated throughout our extensive line of PMC training ammunition and standard hollow point or soft point ammunition. All PMC cartridges must pass through the rigorous inspection of our electronic powder check station. This station accurately measures the propellant charge in each round. If the propellant in any cartridge varies by a tiny amount - just two tenths of one grain - the system stops and that cartridge is discarded. 50 rounds per box except where noted.

name: ACOG 3.5x35
description: In 1991, the Trijicon ACOG was chosen by the U.S Navy SEALs for testing, then operations. In 1995, German GSG9 SWAT chose the 3.5x35 model for their 550 rifles. Ever since, the ACOG 3.5x35 riflescope has remained a favorite among competitive shooters, law enforcement and freedom-loving civilians everywhere.

name: Sight Line Laser
description: TruGlo Sight•Line Compact handgun laser is lightweight and designed for concealed carry. Bright laser marks the point of impact on target with constant or pulsing beams. Laser is adjustable for windage and elevation with adjustable recoil lug for versatile positioning. Fits Picatinny, Weaver, Glock and many other pistol rails. Single battery design for easy replacement without removing laser from the rail with a battery life of 8 hours continuous and 18 hours in pulse mode. Includes CR1/3N battery.

name: Handgun Hunter
description: Hornady Handgun Hunter ammunition is built around a bullet as rough and rugged as the conditions and game demand. The MonoFlex handgun projectile is manufactured with a tough copper alloy that achieves deep penetration and 95% weight retention. Bullet expansion across a range of velocities is aided with an elastomer material added to the bullet’s open cavity. Upon impact, the elastomer compresses, then pushes out and causes the bullet to expand faster than a standard hollow point design.

name: Hunting Load
description: American Tactical Hunting Load for Shotgun Hunting

name: VCOG 1-8x28
description: The development of the Trijicon VCOG 1-8x28 riflescope was inspired by requests from the U.S. Military. The result is a tough-as-nails, absolutely precise riflescope that gives users the ability to engage targets from CQB to long range with confidence. Expect superior glass that provides exceptional clarity and color with zero distortion. Choose from MOA or MRAD reticles.

name: XPS2
description: The XPS2 is the shortest, smallest and lightest EOTech model holographic weapon sight available without night vision. Its size and weight make it convenient for hunters and law enforcement officers to carry. It is also fast and runs on a single 123 battery. The compact, single-lithium-battery configuration leaves more rail space than ever for rear iron sights or magnifiers. This sight has the same body style as the XPS3 model, but the XPS2 does not have night vision-compatibility.

name: Black Cloud FS Steel
description: Equipped with the FLITECONTROL FLEX wad, Black Cloud delivers improved pattern density and consistency through both ported and standard waterfowl chokes. The wad's redesigned rear-deploying petals and side-mounted vents stimulate the payload for separation from the wad at the ideal moment for dense, deadly patterns. Plus, the efficient Catalyst lead-free primer and clean-burning, temperature-stable propellant significantly decrease residue in the barrel.

name: Ruggedized Rear ScopeCap
description: The Rear Ruggedized ScopeCap is a simple, rugged, and low-profile solution to protect your scope's rear lens. Their signature flipper tab is integral to the ScopeCap and allows for fast, easy removal from your scope's bezel. When doffed, the ScopeCap has a lower profile than traditional flip-style scope caps.

name: UMC Rifle
description: For varmint hunting, target shooting, training exercises or any other high-volume shooting situation, UMC centerfire rifle ammunition offers great value with absolutely no compromise in quality or performance. Loaded right here in the USA, UMC rifle ammunition offers the choice of either metal-case or jacketed hollow point bullets in several popular rifle calibers.

name: Superformance
description: Superformance uses progressive propellants that take your favorite V-MAX, NTX, SST, CX, and InterLock, bullets to levels of performance that are simply unattainable with conventional ammunition.

name: Standard Rifle
description: Extensive line of rifle ammunition designed especially for big game hunting. Only the best quality components are used during production to ensure that our cartridges are accurate dependable and effective. Our constant quality improvements are based on the continual feedback from our customers, accurate, depend able and effective.

name: Rifle
description: Sellier & Bellot ammunition is designed and field-tested to provide shooters and hunters with the widest selection of caliber offerings and the highest performance projectiles on the market today.

name: Outfitter
description: From the backcountry to the back-forty, trust your hunt to Outfitter ammunition. Featuring corrosion resistant nickel-plated cases that are sealed watertight and topped with the accurate and rugged CX bullet, Outfitter ammunition is designed to perform under the toughest conditions.

name: ACOG 1.5x16
description: With all the performance of the original Trijicon ACOG (Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight) wrapped in a smaller 5.1 oz package, the 1.5x16S model is perfect for fast-moving tactical teams and speed-oriented competitions. This highly compact riflescope provides platforms like M16/M4 with excellent fire control capability and lightning fast target acquisition. Using Trijicon's Bindon Aiming Concept (BAC) feature, users can keep both eyes open while engaging targets and maintaining maximum situational awareness.

name: Custom
description: Shooters looking for supreme accuracy and maximum knock-down power turn to Hornady Custom ammunition. Loaded with a variety of Hornady bullets for rifle and pistol, the excellent terminal performance of Hornady Custom ammunition makes it the preferred choice for hunters, competitive shooters, and plinkers.

name: RMR Dual Defense Kit
description: The Trijicon Dual Defense Kit combines the legendary RMR and the Suppressor/Optic Height Sight Set into one, easy-to-use kit. This new kit adds speed and precision to your Commercial Variant M17/M18 self-defense, law enforcement, military, competition, or target pistol. The Suppressor/Optic Height sights are engineered to the optimal height so that the iron sight can be seen through the optic lens. Having co-witnessed iron sights helps you quickly acquire the red dot, and if necessary, provides a backup aiming solution.

name: Magtech Handgun
description: Full Metal Jacket projectiles are the ideal choice for recreational target shooting and training. When you want great value without sacrificing quality and performance, you can rely on Magtech full metal jacket ammunition to deliver results.

name: Dovetail Mount
description: Dovetail polymer replacement mount for the CZ Shadow 1.

name: AccuPoint
description: When you want the very best without compromise, without fail, without second guessing, go with a Trijicon AccuPoint riflescope. Designed with battery-free illumination that's always on, the AccuPoint is as technologically sophisticated as it is tough.

name: Subsonic Rifle
description: For noise reduction that’s real—not just relative—there’s finally a solution. Federal Subsonic gives both hunters and target shooters effective performance and extreme accuracy at velocities that deliver whisper-quiet shooting through suppressors. Engineers selected some of Federal’s most trusted bullet designs, including Fusion and Fusion Tipped, and modified them for muzzle velocities of 1,000 fps. At just below the speed of sound, this eliminates the harsh supersonic crack of standard-velocity ammunition that suppressors can’t silence without sacrificing the precision or performance shooters need. Hunting loads with Fusion or Fusion Tipped bullets provide lethal expansion and penetration, while target loads offer accuracy and consistency at the range.

name: FAST Magnifier Mount
description: FAST is a series of optic mounts and platforms that provide end users with a quicker sight picture than standard height mounts. A 2.26" optical centerline height provides faster/easier reticle acquisition while wearing electronic EarPro/communications headsets, night vision goggles and gas masks and allows for more rapid visual processing of the battlefield by promoting a heads-up posture.

name: USA Valor Pistol
description: Winchester celebrates its commitment to American freedom with the USA VALOR™ ammunition series. From World War I through modern day deployments, Winchester remains steadfast in its support of U.S. Warfighters as the largest small caliber enterprise in the world. Your purchase of Winchester’s USA VALOR™ Series helps support Folds of Honor.

name: Military Service Grade Handgun
description: Featuring high quality Winchester components, this ammunition delivers outstanding reliability. This ammunition is loaded with a full metal jacket bullet which is known for its positive functioning and exceptional accuracy. On impact this bullet does not expand and is ideal for target shooting. Reliable, affordable loads for the high-volume shooter. Whether for practice, target shooting or training exercises, Military Service Grade ammunition is a superb choice for high volume shooting. This ammunition is new production, non-corrosive, in reloadable brass cases.

name: Super-X Xpert
description: Consistent, Dependable Performance. Exceptional Quality and Outstanding Performance. Time Proven Dependability. Long-range knock-down. One-Piece Hinged Wad: For consistent, tight patterns and reduced felt-recoil. Famous 209 Primer and Clean Burning Powder Reliable ignition and consistent velocity.

name: MBUS Sight Rear
description: The MBUS (Magpul Back-Up Sight) is a low-cost, color injection molded, folding back-up sight. The dual aperture MBUS Rear Sight is adjustable for windage and fits most 1913 Picatinny rail equipped weapons, but is specifically tailored to the AR15/M16 platform. FEATURES: Impact resistant polymer construction provides light weight and resists operational abuse; Spring-loaded flip up sight easily activated from either side or by pressing the top; Detent and spring pressure keeps sight erect but allows for unobstructed folding under impact, etc.; Clamps to MIL-STD-1913 Picatinny/STANAG 4694 receiver rail and provides the same height-over-bore as standard A2 irons; Protective wings shield the dual, same plane flip apertures; Sight can still be folded with either large or small aperture in position; Detent knob easily and positively adjusts windage.

name: Range Dynamics Handgun
description: Fiocchi's Range Dynamics is ideal for a day at the local club with family and friends, practicing for your next competition, or headed to a training course to develop your skills.

name: Optic Ready Plate
description: Elevate your shooting experience with Colt's high-quality Optics-Ready Plates, designed to seamlessly integrate with your Colt revolvers for quick and easy red dot sight installation. When you're ready to upgrade your King Cobra Target, their precision-engineered plates are the perfect solution for enhancing accuracy and speed. These plates are compatible with popular red dot optics, featuring the Shield RMSc and Holosun 507k footprints, providing you with the flexibility to choose your ideal sighting system. Installation is straightforward, as each plate attaches securely to your revolver using the rear sight hole and screws for a solid and reliable fit.

name: Superformance Varmint
description: SuperformanceVarmint ammunition delivers muzzle velocity increases of 100 to 200 feet per second from EVERY gun. Accuracy, increased range, flatter trajectory, less wind drift and devastating terminal results are all realized with SuperformanceVarmint ammunition. 20 rounds per box.

name: Power-Shok Rifle
description: The traditional lead-core hunting bullets in Federal Power-Shok rifle loads provide solid accuracy and power at an affordable price. They feature reliable Federal brass, primers and powder and are suited to a wide variety of medium and big games.

name: Stride
description: Enjoy clear, stable thermal imaging with a true 1X magnification that keeps your natural perception of surroundings. The ergonomic button layout ensures smooth, precise control-whether you're hunting, patrolling, or exploring.

name: NATO
description: Backed by generations of legendary excellence, Winchester "USA White Box" stands for consistent performance and outstanding value, offering high-quality ammunition to suit a wide range of hunter's and shooter's needs.

name: ROF Mount
description: Made in the USA, the Reptilia ROF red dot mount is a drop-in upgrade for magnified scope mounts. It is compatible with Geissele Automatics' Super Precision 30mm optic mount, and adds a mounting point for a red dot to provide a fast, close-range optic to your magnified scope.

name: Scope Cover
description: Protect your scope during storage with a Burris Scope Cover. The waterproof scope cover prevents corrosion and fogging. Made from super-soft, breathable fabric that shields your scope from dust and dings.

name: 3K Scope Ring
description: Ruger scope ring designed to fit a scope with a 1" scope tube diameter and a 32mm objective diameter. Sold individually. Clam package.

name: ELEV8 High Rise
description: The ARMASPEC ELEV8 Series High Rise Optic Risers offer a precise and secure solution for elevating red dot optics with a T1/2 footprint, These risers maintain a low-profile and sleek appearance, minimizing the risk of snags while providing a stable platform for optic mounting. The increased height facilitates swift sight acquisition, particularly useful when using a gas mask or passive night vision equipment. With their see through design, these risers allow for the use of iron sights in case of optic failure. This not only trims down overall weight but also ensures robust durability. The adaptable design of the ELEV8 Series Optic Risers enhances versatility in various shooting scenarios, making them a dependable choice for firearm enthusiasts or the professional.

name: Range Dynamics
description: Some days, it’s all about punching holes and ringing steel. Fiocchi’s Range Dynamics centerfire rifle cartridges have you covered for high-volume fun, equipment testing, and skill development. Available for all the popular chamber sizes, Range Dynamics ammunition utilizes flight-stable full metal jacket boattail bullets combined with the same high-quality components and construction serious shooters have come to expect from Fiocchi.

name: Ranger Rifle
description: Winchester offers the widest selection of rifle ammo for sale. Whether you’re looking for rifle ammo for hunting, target practice or competitive shooting, Winchester has you covered. Find our closest Winchester Ammunition retailer near you.

name: Custom Rifle
description: Shooters looking for supreme accuracy and maximum knock-down power turn to Hornady Custom ammunition. Loaded with a variety of Hornady bullets for rifle and pistol, the excellent terminal performance of Hornady Custom ammunition makes it the preferred choice for hunters, competitive shooters, and plinkers.

name: Hevi-Hitter
description: Balance the sheer power of tungsten with the patterning and practicality of steel to deliver better lethality on ducks and geese. HEVI-Shot HEVI-Hitter devotes 20 percent of its payload to 12 g/cc tungsten and layers it over 80 percent steel shot. This carefully engineered blend brings out the best in both materials, offering a large, effective pattern at close and moderate targets, as well as the pellet count, power and density needed to drop distant birds.

name: Maxima Horizontal Rings
description: Maxima Horizontal scope rings are designed" engineered and manufactured by Warne's expert staff in Tualatin" Oregon. Utilizing proprietary sintered steel technology" Maxima Horizontal offers unwavering strength and precision in a stylish" yet traditional form. 4 screw ring caps" along with a unique recoil key and clamp offer easy installation and unrivaled holding strength. With classic lines" and Warne's return to zero guarantee" Maxima Horizontal are the new standard.

name: Core-Lokt
description: Since 1939, more hunters have relied on Remington Core-Lokt than any other big game ammunition, and rightly so. It's filled more tags on more continents than any other load. Core-Lokt is the original controlled expansion bullet. Its time-proven performance has made it hunting's first choice for over 75 years. The tapered copper jacket is locked to a solid lead core delivering massive 2X expansion, weight retention and consistent on-game results. Available in soft point and pointed soft point versions, and in a range of bullet weights for virtually every centerfire hunting caliber made.

name: MK2 Red Dot Mount
description: Engineered for precision and built to last, the MK2 series elevates your shooting experience with unmatched reliability and style. These MK2 Mounts are designed for shooters seeking a robust and refined scope mounting solution. Featuring a next-generation design, these mounts combine enhanced functionality with a premium aesthetic.

name: Rimfire
description: Aguila rimfire ammunition is manufactured to ensure optimal reliability, accuracy, and performance. The ammo features Aguila prime technology, which is engineered and tested to Olympic Shooting Standards.

name: Centerfire Rifle
description: Ideal for target practice and plinking. High quality components for precise and dependable performance.

name: Champion Rimfire
description: Federal Champion rimfire ammunition provides accurate, affordable performance for target shooting.

name: HEVI-Steel
description: Major Kinetic Energy. The first all-steel shotshell from HEVI-Shot is pushed out at a blistering 1500 fps, compared to competing fast steel loads, which run at 1450fps (12g 3” 1.25oz). This increase in speed delivers 9% more energy at 30 yards and 8% at 40! In short, you will get more knockdown power and fewer crippled birds. Combining higher velocity, a best-in-class wad and precision manufacturing techniques delivers the ultimate in performance. HEVI-Steel hits hard every time!

name: RFX 44 Adapter Plate
description: Shield RMSc/ACRO Mounting Adapter Plate for RFX44 Closed Emitter Green Dot Sight.

name: Rattler V2
description: The Rattler V2 includes features familiar to AGM Rattler users, with some additional game-changing improvements such as an upgraded battery compartment that accommodates a rechargeable battery extending run time to 11 hours and a new 12-micron thermal sensor that has the highest sensitivity rating (sub-20 mk) on the market. Notable features include Shot Activated Recording, a simplified menu layout, and 10 reticle options with multiple zeroing profiles for various calibers and rifles. The scope also comes with a custom ADM QD Mount for easy removal and reattachment, Wi-Fi hotspot connectivity through the AGM app, a user-friendly, raised 5-button layout for easy navigation, even with gloves, and much more!

name: Trophy Grade Rifle
description: Manufactured to Nosler's strict quality standards, Trophy Grade ammunition uses Nosler brass and Nosler bullets to attain optimum performance, no matter where your hunting trip takes you. Whether you want your ammunition loaded with AccuBond, Partition Ballistic Tip or , E-Tip. Nosler Trophy Grade Ammunition will have the right load for the right game.

name: Tenmile
description: The Trijicon Tenmile is a first focal plane riflescope that lets you dial-in long-range shots in any environment or light with confidence. Expect pinpoint precision at multiple ranges, all-weather performance and outstanding quality and design for repeatable precision. The MRAD Precision Tree reticle offers precise wind and range holds and the exposed zero stop elevation adjuster allows you to quickly return to zero. Includes Sunshade, Tenebraex Flip Caps, Scopecoat, 3mm and 1.5mm Hex key, repositionable magnification knob and replacement screw, CR2032 battery, quick reference guide, and logo sticker.

name: Backcountry Defense Handgun
description: Hornady introduces Backcountry Defense ammunition. Featuring the DGH (Dangerous Game Handgun) bullet, providing maximum penetration and no deflection, Backcountry Defense delivers peace of mind from your favorite backcountry sidearm.

name: AUS Mount
description: Introducing the AUS Mount for magnified optics, from Reptilia. Driven by the request of an end user group, the AUS Mount is the culmination of a 2 year development program. Like the DOT Mount line, the AUS Mount attaches to any M1913 Picatinny rail via the anti-snag spring-loaded nitrided steel clamp and custom bolt mounting system which can be tightened with either a 5/32 hex or a flat blade driver to sit flush with the body of the mount for a low-profile, streamline design. Also like the DOT Mount line, the AUS mount is machined from a single piece of billet 7075-T6 aluminum and is finished with MIL-STD Type III, Class 2, hard anodize coating. The AUS is compatible with all of Reptilia's existing 30mm ROF line, and will be compatible with several new ROF products launching over the coming months. Like all Reptilia products, the AUS Mount is 100% Made in the USA.

name: Superformance Varmint
description: SuperformanceVarmint ammunition delivers muzzle velocity increases of 100 to 200 feet per second from EVERY gun. Accuracy, increased range, flatter trajectory, less wind drift and devastating terminal results are all realized with SuperformanceVarmint ammunition. 20 rounds per box.

name: Light Weight Ring/Base Combo Savage A17
description: Talley's Lightweight Scope Mount features a unique, one-piece construction extruded from 7000 series alloy and precision CNC-machined to its final design. It has no joint between the scope and the rifle which ultimately provides more strength and durability than most steel rings and bases, but with a lighter overall weight. This model is compatible with Savage A17 with a round receiver and Accutrigger rifles.

name: ACOG 2x20
description: The Trijicon ACOG 2x20 riflescope is well-suited to firearms with limited space, like UZI, H&K or MP-5 9mm submachine guns. With a step-up in fixed magnification, this illuminated reticle riflescope increases target detection distance in any lighting conditions. The Trijicon The Trijicon Compact ACOG Mount w/ Q-LOC Technology features a Mil-Spec drop test rated 6061-T6 aluminum design, with an easy to use one handed tool less mounting system. The spring-loaded design allows for constant retention and maintaining of zero even if the knobs are not tightened.

name: Rimfire Rings
description: Burris Rimfire Rings are for reliable performance under any conditions. Use with rimfire and airgun optics. They are compatible with .22" grooved receivers and feature durable, strong gripping power.

name: Cowboy Action Handgun
description: A lead bullet with a flat nose provides flawless performance while shooting your favorite iron. The protective coating reduces wear and fouling on your firearm. The double base powder provides consistent velocities across temperature swings resulting in higher degrees of accuracy with the added benefit of reduced recoil. When you want to get western, choose Fiocchi Cowboy ammunition.

name: Handgun
description: Full Metal Jacket projectiles are the ideal choice for recreational target shooting and extended training sessions at the range. When you want great value without sacrificing quality and performance, you can rely on Sellier & Bellot full metal jacket ammunition to deliver reliable results.
